options_zh.A: 與同儕討論專案章程的必要性
options_zh.B: 制定專案章程並呈報送審以取得核准
options_zh.C: 解釋專案章程是確保對範疇和交付標的達成共識，並界定專案經理職責所不可或缺的

question_text: A company is transitioning from a predictive to an agile approach. How should the project manager resolve this situation in their new role as servant leader?

options.A: Review the organizational process assets (OPAs) to find similar situations and review the resolution actions taken,
options.B: Request that the team use the next sprint to complete all technical debt remaining from the previous sprints.
options.C: Extend the sprints to 3 weeks to allow the work requested by the product owner to be completed.
options.D: Encourage the whole team to be empowered and accountable for the decisions made according to their roles,

concept_tag: 驗收準則 (Acceptance Criteria)
question_text_zh: 一家公司正從預測型方法轉型為敏捷方法。在過去兩次的短衝審查會議中，產品負責人抱怨開發團隊，指出增量未達到使用者故事中定義的驗收準則。開發團隊則抱怨產品負責人所定義的短衝待辦清單項目無法在專案開始時約定的 2 週短衝內交付。專案經理以其身為僕人式領導的新角色，應如何解決這種情況？

options_zh.A: 檢視組織過程資產（OPA），尋找類似情況並檢視所採取的解決措施
options_zh.B: 要求團隊利用下一個短衝完成先前短衝留下的所有技術債務
options_zh.C: 將短衝延長至 3 週，以利完成產品負責人要求的工作
options_zh.D: 鼓勵整個團隊獲得授權，並依據各自的角色對所做的決策負責

options.D: Negotiating

options_zh.A: 強制力
options_zh.B: 衝突解決
options_zh.C: 情緒智商（情商）
options_zh.D: 談判

What two actions should the project manager take to prevent the team from being unqualified? (Choose two)

options.A: Exclude the activities from the roadmap
options.B: Encourage working in pairs and knowledge sharing

options.E: Increase the time estimates on the activities that require such abilities

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)

question_text_zh: 在專案執行期間，專案經理注意到只有一名團隊成員具備建置產品所需的某項技術技能。專案經理擔心這可能會對未來的品質和時程產生影響，因為即將進行的大多數活動至少需要三名具備此特定技能的人員。專案經理應採取哪兩項行動來避免團隊能力不足？（選擇兩項）

options_zh.A: 從路線圖中排除這些活動
options_zh.B: 鼓勵結對工作與知識分享
options_zh.C: 向整個團隊傳授新技能
options_zh.D: 促成由外部講師進行的培訓活動
options_zh.E: 增加需要此類能力之活動的時間估算

options.A: Review the project objectives with the project sponsor to agree on more realistic and achievable project plans and deliverables
options.B: Request more funding from the project sponsor to hire additional skilled resources and to incorporate additional quality in the project delivery approach and outcome
options.C: Conduct periodical reviews of the project plans, objectives, and deliverables to ensure all relevant data are captured to continue making informed project decisions
options.D: Create a business case after performing a market review, and then submit it to the sponsor to modify the project deliverable to meet the newly defined objectives

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 / 2.4 / 2.6 整合計畫、資源與財務
concept_tag: 商業企劃案 (Business Case)
question_text_zh: 專案經理被選定負責交付組織的關鍵旗艦解決方案之一。關鍵成功因素包括敏捷性、市場適應能力以及對市場產品的快速回應。專案經理應採取的關鍵活動之一是什麼，以確保公司成功？

options_zh.A: 與專案贊助者審查專案目標，以就更切合實際且可實現的專案計畫和交付標的達成共識
options_zh.B: 向專案贊助者要求更多資金，以聘請更多具備技能的資源，並在專案交付方法和成果中納入額外的品質要求
options_zh.C: 定期審查專案計畫、目標和交付標的，以確保掌握所有相關資料，從而持續做出明智的專案決策
options_zh.D: 在進行市場審查後建立商業論證，然後提交給贊助者以修改專案交付標的，使其符合新定義的目標

question_text: A labor union contract negotiation is delaying the completion of a project to build a new manufacturing plant. The project was about to start the first phase of equipment installation at the plant when the negotiation began. How should the project manager address the situation?

options.A: Meet with the project team to determine options for risk mitigation.
options.B: Log the issue and follow the planned actions in the risk response plan.
options.C: Acquire contract resources and submit a change request for the cost impact.
options.D: Escalate the issue to the steering committee to ask for mitigation support.

options_list.text: Meet with the project team to determine options for risk mitigation.
Log the issue and follow the planned actions in the risk response plan.
Acquire contract resources and submit a change request for the cost impact.
Escalate the issue to the steering committee to ask for mitigation support.

options_zh.A: 與專案團隊會面以確定風險減輕方案
options_zh.B: 記錄該議題並遵循風險應對計畫中的既定行動

options_zh.A: 制定資源管理計畫並確保提供適當的培訓
options_zh.B: 更換現有的專案團隊成員
options_zh.C: 將工作委外給專業廠商完成

options_zh.A: 審查專案管理計畫。
options_zh.B: 建立詳細的營運手冊。

options_zh.D: 由於專案管理計畫已獲得核准，因此維持任務指派不變。

question_text_zh: 專案贊助者指示專案經理起草專案章程。專案贊助者要求專案經理讓某一特定利害關係人參與，以提供必要資源。然而，該利害關係人認為使用該專案交付標的沒有任何好處，因而拒絕參與。專案經理應該怎麼做來解決這個問題？

options_zh.A: 與該利害關係人會面，討論交付標的的效益與影響。
options_zh.B: 將該利害關係人視為一項風險，並與專案團隊評估可能的解決方案。
options_zh.C: 改善與該利害關係人的溝通，以取得其未來的協助。
options_zh.D: 由於該議題涉及組織政治性質，將其呈報給專案贊助者。

options.A: Stakeholders are satisfied with the current status.
options.B: The project is under budget and on schedule
options.C: The project is aligned with the project charter
options.D: The protect is aligned with the benefits management plan

chapter_tag: 02. 建立基礎—願景、利害關係人與治理 (專案章程、利害關係人參與、治理結構)

question_text_zh: 在專案審查會議期間，專案贊助者擔心專案可能無法如期交付成果。基於這點，專案經理正在評估專案狀態。專案經理應該使用什麼資訊作為專案確實正在交付價值的指標？

options_zh.A: 利害關係人對當前狀態感到滿意。
options_zh.B: 專案在預算內且符合時程進度。
options_zh.C: 專案與專案章程保持一致。
options_zh.D: 專案與效益管理計畫書保持一致。

options.A: Solve the issue for the team member.
options.B: Perform a brainstorming session to address the issue and add the solution to the sprint.
options.C: Escalate the issue to the software vendor for technical resolution
options.D: Coach the team to come up with their own solution and add it to the next sprint

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.5 / 2.7 / 2.8 採購、品質與時程
concept_tag: 供應商與廠商管理 (Vendor Management)
question_text_zh: 在每日站立會議中，有人提出了一個阻礙某位團隊成員推進工作的障礙。專案經理發現這是一個技術問題。專案經理應如何優先處理這個關鍵障礙？

options_zh.A: 由專案經理替該團隊成員解決此問題。
options_zh.B: 進行腦力激盪會議以解決問題，並將解決方案加入目前的短衝中。
options_zh.C: 將問題呈報給軟體供應商以尋求技術解決方案。
options_zh.D: 指導團隊提出他們自己的解決方案，並將其加入下一個短衝中。

question_text: Two team members are arguing about which technology they should use when implementing iteration tasks. The predictive approach was broken into several legations that need to be completed on time so as not to jeopardize the projects timely completion. What should the project manager do to resolve this issue and help the team move on to the next iteration?

options.A: Postpone the selection of the technology used until more information is gathered
options.B: Suggest their own approach to solve the issue and ask the team to follow it
options.C: Call for an open dialogue which the team will arrive at through consensus
options.D: Allow the team to decide since the teams should be autonomous

options_list.text: Postpone the selection of the technology used until more information is gathered

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 發展整合專案計畫與基礎
concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 兩位團隊成員在執行迭代任務時，對應使用哪種技術產生了爭執。該預測型方法已被拆解為數個迭代，必須按時完成以避免危及專案的如期完工。專案經理應該怎麼做來解決這個問題，並幫助團隊推進到下一個迭代？

options_zh.A: 延後技術的選擇，直到收集到更多資訊為止。
options_zh.B: 提出自己的方法來解決問題，並要求團隊遵循。
options_zh.C: 號召公開對話，讓團隊藉此達成共識。
options_zh.D: 允許團隊自行決定，因為團隊應當是自主的。

question_text: Halfway through project execution, stakeholders ask for equipment that was expected to be procured. This is because the initial requirements were changed during a previous meeting. What should the project manager have done to avoid this situation?

options.B: Ensured procurement contracts were able be canceled when situations like this arise
options.C: Ensured project requirements were validated and communicated with the procurement team
options.D: Ensured changing stakeholder needs and requests were properly monitored

Ensured procurement contracts were able be canceled when situations like this arise

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)

question_text_zh: 在專案執行到一半時，利害關係人要求提供原本預期採購的設備。專案經理說明設備已完成採購，但與利害關係人目前要求的不同。這是因為在先前的會議中最初的需求已經發生變更。專案經理本應採取何種做法來避免這種情況？

options_zh.A: 確保在需求變更時已向所有利害關係人發送溝通訊息。
options_zh.B: 確保在此類情況發生時採購合約可以被取消。
options_zh.C: 確保專案需求已得到驗證，並已與採購團隊進行溝通。
options_zh.D: 確保對利害關係人不斷變化的需求與要求進行適當監控。

question_text: After reviewing the project management plan with key stakeholders, the project manager was told that an 18-month release plan was unacceptable and the product should launch in six months. Based on the new timeline, what should the project manager do?

options.A: Plan for overtime, apply crashing and fast tracking and share the risk of failure with project stakeholders.
options.B: Review the project backlog looking for high-priority items and come up with a minimum viable product (MVP) that fits the expected timeline
options.C: Seek approval with the sponsor to triple the project budget, hiring more people to compensate for the compressed schedule
options.D: Go over the critical path with stakeholders, explaining why it is not possible to deliver all the scope in the expected timeline

chapter_tag: 03. 定義範疇、價值和成功準則 (WBS、待辦清單、允收準則、MVP)

concept_tag: 最小可行產品 (MVP)
question_text_zh: 在與關鍵利害關係人審查專案管理計畫書後，專案經理被告知18個月的發布計畫無法接受，產品應在六個月內推出。根據新的時程，專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 規劃加班、採用趕工和快速跟進，並與專案利害關係人分擔失敗的風險。
options_zh.B: 審查專案待辦清單以尋找高優先順序項目，並提出符合預期時程的最小可行產品（MVP）。
options_zh.C: 尋求贊助者核准將專案預算增加為三倍，僱用更多人員以彌補壓縮的時程。
options_zh.D: 與利害關係人一起檢視關鍵路徑，解釋為什麼不可能在預期時程內交付所有範疇。

options.A: Emphasize to the team that each member is responsible for their story but the team is collectively responsible for finishing the sprint
options.B: Ask the team to address this at the next sprint planning instead of at the retrospective
options.C: Suggest that the team assign stones at the beginning of the sprint based on each person's strengths to maximize performance
options.D: Work with the product owner to remove the story from the sprint because the points cannot be splits

question_text_zh: 一個敏捷團隊在短衝中完成了10個故事中的9個。在回顧會議期間，少數團隊成員指出他們完成了自己的所有故事，但有一位團隊成員未能完成故事。敏捷領導者應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 向團隊強調每位成員對自己的故事負責，但團隊對完成整個短衝負有共同責任。
options_zh.B: 要求團隊在下一次短衝規劃會議上討論此問題，而不是在回顧會議上。
options_zh.C: 建議團隊在短衝開始時根據每個人的專長分配故事，以使績效最大化。
options_zh.D: 與產品負責人合作將該故事從短衝中移除，因為點數無法被拆分。

options.A: Apply lean manufacturing to limit the team's work
options.B: Increase retrospectives to deliver results fast
options.C: Make work visible using kanban boards.
options.D: Incorporate small batches of work into the project

options_zh.A: 應用精實製造來限制團隊的工作。
options_zh.B: 增加回顧會議以快速交付成果。
options_zh.C: 使用看板讓工作視覺化。
options_zh.D: 在專案中納入小批量的工作。

question_text_zh: 專案經理正在啟動一個新專案，專案團隊成員分布在不同國家。團隊原本打算使用某個特定工具進行虛擬會議。然而，該工具在其中一位團隊成員所在的國家無法使用。專案經理應如何處理這種情況？

options_zh.A: 聯繫專案贊助者，將該團隊成員從專案中替換除名。
options_zh.B: 要求該團隊成員搬到該工具可以使用的其他地點。
options_zh.C: 啟動專案，並在該工具可用之前使用電子郵件與該團隊成員溝通。
options_zh.D: 調查所有團隊成員皆可使用的其他替代虛擬會議工具。

options.A: Accept the situation knowing there is schedule slack available to release on an incremental basis when necessary.
options.B: Call each team member to gain their perspective on the problem, then bring the whole team together to discuss a solution.
options.C: Send each team member a direct email indicating that disciplinary action is likely if they do not change their attitude.
options.D: Contact the project sponsor to request approval to release the current team and hire replacement personnel.

options_zh.A: 接受現狀，因為知道時程上有寬裕時間（slack），必要時可以採漸進式發布。
options_zh.B: 致電每位團隊成員以了解他們對問題的看法，然後將整個團隊召集在一起討論解決方案。
options_zh.C: 向每位團隊成員發送直接的電子郵件，指出如果他們不改變態度，很可能會受到懲戒處分。
options_zh.D: 聯繫專案贊助者，請求核准解散目前團隊並僱用替換人員。

options.B: Refer to the resource management plan to find out if more business analysts may be assigned to process the requirements changes
options.C: Point out to the project team and the customer that all information concerning the timeline of the project should be communicated by the project manager.

options_zh.A: 向變更管制委員會（CCB）提交變更申請，以反映新需求與專案更長的時程。

options_zh.D: 解釋重要消息的發布只能使用可追溯的溝通方法。

options_zh.A: 將情況告知指導委員會並請求額外資源。
options_zh.B: 在每個據點協調虛擬與面對面會議以促進溝通。

options_zh.D: 將此情況告知專案贊助者並請求文化適應培訓。

options.A: Update the lessons learned report and the risk log to reflect that this risk has materialized.
options.B: Revise the project management plan and move the task to a time when the technical resource will be available.
options.C: Consult the risk register for an appropriate planned risk response and implement.
options.D: Review the business requirement with stakeholders and exclude the task assigned to the technical resource.

concept_tag: 專案管理計畫書 (Project Management Plan)
question_text_zh: 專案經理在混合式環境中領導一個軟體開發專案。在專案規劃期間，專案經理識別出一項風險：關鍵路徑項目所需的技術資源在需要時可能無法到位。在需要該資源的前一週，該技術工程師發生個人緊急情況必須請假。專案經理接下來應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 更新經驗學習報告和風險記錄簿，以反映該風險已經發生。
options_zh.B: 修訂專案管理計畫書，將該工作改移至該技術資源可用的時間執行。
options_zh.C: 查閱風險登錄表以獲取適當的已規劃風險因應措施並予以執行。
options_zh.D: 與利害關係人審查商業需求，並排除指派給該技術資源的工作任務。

question_text: A project manager finds out that the required project status reports have not been filled out by most team members. options.A: Reprimand the team members who did not fill out the status reports.
options.B: Justify the team members' behavior to the project sponsor.
options.C: Quickly put together a report that will satisfy the project sponsor.
options.D: Discuss the issue with the team members at fault.

options_list.text: Reprimand the team members who did not fill out the status reports.
Justify the team members' behavior to the project sponsor.
Quickly put together a report that will satisfy the project sponsor.

options_zh.A: 訓斥未填寫狀況報告的團隊成員。

question_text_zh: 專案經理被要求提供有關其中一位團隊成員的績效回饋。由於目前缺乏評估員工績效的指標，專案經理希望從專案團隊中收集更多意見。專案經理接下來應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 評估所展現出的任務當責性
options_zh.B: 決定適當的做法
options_zh.C: 分析團隊成員的影響力
options_zh.D: 識別決策權威的層級

chapter_tag: 03. 定義範疇、價值和成功準則 (WBS、待辦清單、允收準則、MVP)

concept_tag: 產品待辦清單 (Product Backlog)
question_text_zh: 一家公司正在協助其客戶推出一項創新產品。在短衝檢視會議期間，產品負責人發現該產品並未包含先前已在產品待辦清單中排定優先順序的關鍵功能。專案經理下一步應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 延長短衝時程，以便團隊能夠處理遺漏的功能。
options_zh.B: 告知產品負責人此問題需要呈報至高階主管層級。
options_zh.C: 與產品負責人和團隊協作，以規劃下一個短衝。
options_zh.D: 啟動變更請求流程以納入這些遺漏的功能。

question_text: A project manager is assigned to a new project team that has several stakeholders who can have significant influence over the project outcomes. The project manager categorized the stakeholders into four different groups and wants to define the communication strategy. How should the project manager handle communication?

options.A: Utilize a uniform communication structure across all groups.
options.B: Define and direct communication to influential stakeholders.
options.C: Describe the four groups in the project stakeholder matrix.
options.D: Develop and define a communication strategy for stakeholders.

options_list.text: Utilize a uniform communication structure across all groups.
Define and direct communication to influential stakeholders.
Describe the four groups in the project stakeholder matrix.
Develop and define a communication strategy for stakeholders.

chapter_tag: 06. 溝通與知識傳遞 (溝通管理、資訊發布器、經驗學習)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.7 / 1.8 溝通與知識傳遞
concept_tag: 溝通管理計畫書與溝通方法 (Communication Management)
question_text_zh: 專案經理被指派到一個新的專案團隊，該團隊擁有數名對專案成果具有重大影響力的利害關係人。專案經理已將利害關係人分為四個不同的群組，並希望定義溝通策略。專案經理應當如何處理溝通？

options_zh.A: 在所有群組中使用統一的溝通結構。
options_zh.B: 為有影響力的利害關係人定義並引導溝通。
options_zh.C: 在專案利害關係人矩陣中描述這四個群組。
options_zh.D: 為利害關係人制定並定義溝通策略。

The former project manager gave the new project manager a complete list of people to communicate with, and this client team member is not on it. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Update the communications matrix to ensure that client team member is included.
options.B: Submit a change request to cover extra hours associated with project meetings.
options.C: Increase the project meeting frequency and duration to allow for the extra work required.

chapter_tag: 06. 溝通與知識傳遞 (溝通管理、資訊發布器、經驗學習)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.7 / 1.8 溝通與知識傳遞
concept_tag: 溝通管理計畫書與溝通方法 (Communication Management)
question_text_zh: 專案經理最近接手了一個專案，並注意到一位客戶團隊成員由於對某些專案要素缺乏了解而經常阻礙進度。前任專案經理給了新任專案經理一份完整的溝通對象名單，而該客戶團隊成員並不在名單上。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 更新溝通矩陣以確保納入該客戶團隊成員。
options_zh.B: 提交變更請求以涵蓋與專案會議相關的額外工時。
options_zh.C: 增加專案會議的頻率和時間長度，以因應所需的額外工作。
options_zh.D: 與該客戶團隊成員討論專案會議期間持續延誤的問題。

question_text: A newly commissioned project has had trouble recruiting team members because the turnover rate is high. The human resource (HR) manager has conducted several exit interviews. Many team members have expressed that the project manager has inadequate relationship management competencies. The project manager explains that the exiting team members were lazy. What should the project manager do to prevent this high turnover rate from continuing?

options.A: Be more involved in the team member recruitment process to ensure qualified team members are chosen.
options.B: Develop relationship skills as a leader and also develop the teams' emotional intelligence skills.
options.C: Avoid micromanaging the team, enforce stricter rules, and monitor employees.
options.D: Explain to the recruiting manager that a project is temporary in nature, making it different than an operational environment.

options_list.text: Be more involved in the team member recruitment process to ensure qualified team members are chosen.
Develop relationship skills as a leader and also develop the teams' emotional intelligence skills.
Avoid micromanaging the team, enforce stricter rules, and monitor employees.
Explain to the recruiting manager that a project is temporary in nature, making it different than an operational environment.

chapter_tag: 07. 領導及賦能團隊 (衝突管理、僕人式領導、團隊發展階段、情商)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.2 / 1.3 管理衝突與領導團隊
concept_tag: 情緒智能與同理心 (Emotional Intelligence)
question_text_zh: 一個新委託的專案在招募團隊成員方面遇到了困難，因為人員流動率很高。人力資源（HR）經理進行了數次離職面談。許多團隊成員表示專案經理缺乏足夠的關係管理能力。專案經理則解釋說離職的團隊成員很懶散。專案經理應當採取什麼行動來防止這種高流動率持續下去？

options_zh.A: 更多地參與團隊成員招募流程，以確保選出合格的團隊成員。
options_zh.B: 發展身為領導者的關係技能，同時培養團隊的情緒智商（EQ）技能。
options_zh.C: 避免對團隊進行微觀管理，實施更嚴格的規定並監督員工。
options_zh.D: 向招募經理說明專案具有暫時性的特質，這與營運環境不同。

question_text: A large company has agreed on a business case for an environmental project. The project will cause some major changes in their operations, such as reduction in paper use, which will obviously affect all of the users. What is the first thing the appointed project manager should do?

options.A: Evaluate the impact to the users and create a plan to address it.
options.B: Inform users about the new changes and ask for their collaboration. (C). Ask all managers to collaborate implementing this change to users.
options.D: Start implementing the change so that users will eventually get used to it.

options_list.text: Evaluate the impact to the users and create a plan to address it.

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)

concept_tag: 商業企劃案 (Business Case)
question_text_zh: 一家大公司已就一項環保專案的商業企劃案達成共識。該專案將對其營運帶來一些重大變革，例如減少紙張使用，這顯然會影響到所有使用者。獲指派的專案經理首先應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 評估對使用者的衝擊並制定計畫來因應。
options_zh.B: 告知使用者新變革並請求他們的協作。
options_zh.C: 請求所有經理協作，向使用者實施這項變更。
options_zh.D: 開始實施變革，讓使用者最終逐漸習慣。

options.D: Talk to the resource managers regarding the delay and request additional resources

chapter_tag: 09. 監督進度並保持一致 (實獲值管理 EVM、燃盡圖、績效指標 KPI/OKR)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.6 / 2.9 評估專案狀態與監督績效
concept_tag: 實獲值管理與績效指標 (EVM: CPI / SPI / CV / SV)
question_text_zh: 一個專案團隊已轉向全遠距工作模式。專案經理開始注意到，儘管在每週團隊會議上進行了提醒，一些團隊成員仍未能在計畫日期前完成指派的任務。這可能會導致專案交付延誤。專案經理應當如何解決這種情況？

options_zh.A: 每週兩次向團隊成員傳達交付日期，以確保按時交付。
options_zh.B: 與每位團隊成員安排檢討會談，以找出延誤的根本原因。
options_zh.C: 指導團隊成員在遠距工作環境中工作，以確保生產力。
options_zh.D: 針對延誤問題與資源經理溝通，並請求額外資源。

question_text: In a project, one core team member tends to do all the work and ensures all tasks are completed. This core team member is soon leaving the project, which may make the project vulnerable. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Ensure the activities of this team member are distributed across the project team.
options.B: Assess a mechanism for knowledge transfer among the team members.
options.C: Motivate the team member to stay by providing them with incentives.
options.D: Ask human resources (HR) to counsel the team member to balance the workload.

chapter_tag: 06. 溝通與知識傳遞 (溝通管理、資訊發布器、經驗學習)

concept_tag: 知識傳遞與分享 (Knowledge Transfer)
question_text_zh: 在一個專案中，有一位核心團隊成員往往承擔所有工作並確保所有任務完成。該核心成員即將離開專案，這可能會使專案變得脆弱。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 確保將該團隊成員的活動分配給整個專案團隊。
options_zh.B: 評估團隊成員之間的知識轉移機制。
options_zh.C: 藉由提供獎勵措施激勵該團隊成員留下來。
options_zh.D: 請人力資源（HR）部門對該團隊成員進行輔導以平衡工作量。

question_text: A key team member informs the project manager that they have been accepted to a master's degree program. The team member explains that the first semester of the master's program will coincide with the last phase of the project. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Ask the team member to delegate some of their tasks to another colleague during the last phase of the project.
options.B: Suggest the team member postpone their enrollment in the master's program until the project is completed.
options.C: Ask the team member to inform human resources (HR) about their enrollment in the master's program.
options.D: Assess the team member's commitment to the master's program and its impact on project performance.

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)

question_text_zh: 一位關鍵團隊成員告知專案經理，他們已錄取碩士學位學程。該團隊成員說明碩士學程的第一學期將與專案的最後一個階段重疊。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 要求該團隊成員在專案的最後階段將部分任務委派給另一位同事。
options_zh.B: 建議該團隊成員將碩士學程的入學時間延後到專案完成之後。
options_zh.C: 要求該團隊成員向人力資源（HR）部門通報其錄取碩士學程的事宜。
options_zh.D: 評估該團隊成員對碩士學程的時間投入承諾及其對專案績效的衝擊。

options.A: Discuss with the team and build a workaround plan to immediately deliver the pending requirements specifications.
options.B: Ask the team to wait until they are able to update the requirements specifications.
options.C: Prepare a change request for the change control board (CCB) to remove the missing requirements specifications. IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 36
options.D: Meet with the development team to review and assess the requirements specifications.

question_text_zh: 一位專案經理被指派負責一項處於設計階段中期的牙科設備開發專案。在審查專案原型後，發現遺漏了幾項需求規格說明。專案經理下一步應採取哪項行動？

options_zh.A: 與團隊討論並制定權宜措施，以立即交付擱置的需求規格說明。
options_zh.B: 要求團隊等待，直到他們能夠更新需求規格說明為止。
options_zh.C: 為變更管制委員會（CCB）準備一份變更請求，以移除遺漏的需求規格說明。
options_zh.D: 與開發團隊開會以檢視並評估需求規格說明。

question_text: A project manager is working with an agile team to enhance a product. Due to a tight deadline, the team is trying to crash the schedule by engaging multiple resources to work on the project simultaneously. However, the technical environment is configured to allow only one resource to work on a feature at a time. options.A: Conduct a consensus-building session to decide how to approach the next set of work.
options.B: Escalate the issue to the product owner for resolution.
options.C: Add this conflict to the agenda for discussion at the next daily standup meeting.

chapter_tag: 07. 領導及賦能團隊 (衝突管理、僕人式領導、團隊發展階段、情商)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.2 / 1.3 管理衝突與領導團隊
concept_tag: 衝突管理策略 (Conflict Management)
question_text_zh: 專案經理正與敏捷團隊合作改進一項產品。由於時限緊迫，團隊試圖藉由同時投入多個資源進行專案工作來趕工時程。然而，技術環境的設定限制一次僅允許一個資源處理一項功能。團隊計畫升級技術環境，但無法就推進方案達成一致意見。專案經理首先應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 舉行共識建立會議，以決定如何著手進行下一批工作。

options_zh.A: 針對要執行的工作及其與組織主要目標的對齊情況提供明確的方向，並利用科技工具進行溝通。
options_zh.B: 建立明確的層級環境，並允許他們利用社群網路更快地在專案中運作。
options_zh.C: 培養主動決策的能力，並建立依不同複雜度層級進行決策核准的階層架構。
options_zh.D: 創造一個鼓勵領導力、將雄心轉化為成長機會，並獎勵加班員工的環境。

options.C: Review the project charter for the project approval criteria
options.D: Speak with the team's manager to get extra hours from the team

options_zh.A: 向利害關係人說明任何修改都需要額外的預算。
options_zh.B: 與專案團隊一起檢視未達成的計畫交付標的。
options_zh.C: 檢視專案章程中的專案核准準則。
options_zh.D: 與團隊主管溝通以爭取團隊的額外工時。

options.A: Reducing cost for the customer
options.B: Delivering value to the customer
options.C: Working together as a team
options.D: Finishing the project on schedule

options_zh.B: 為客戶交付價值
options_zh.C: 團隊同心協力合作
options_zh.D: 如期完成專案

options.A: Analyze both projects to determine the most effective use of common resources
options.B: Use resource optimization to justify requesting more resources for the critical project
options.C: Provide schedule optimization training to the project teams to improve their skills.
options.D: Apply fast-tracking techniques to compress the schedule of the critical project

question_text_zh: 專案經理有兩個專案正在同時執行。關鍵專案的工期必須縮短，但專案經理沒有足夠的資源來達成此目標。此外，時程中沒有任何可以重疊執行的活動。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 分析這兩個專案，以確定共同資源最有效的使用方式
options_zh.B: 利用資源最佳化來證明為關鍵專案申請更多資源是合理的
options_zh.C: 為專案團隊提供時程最佳化培訓，以提升他們的技能
options_zh.D: 採用快速跟進技術來壓縮關鍵專案的時程

options.D: Review the communications management plan and communicate which technology is to be used to develop, transmit, and store project artifacts,

chapter_tag: 02. 建立基礎—願景、利害關係人與治理 (專案章程、利害關係人參與、治理結構)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.1 / 1.4 / 3.1 願景、利害關係人與治理

question_text_zh: 一位在軟體開發專案中工作的專案經理向軟體開發人員詢問某項工作的狀態。開發人員回答該工作已於 1 週前交付，並提到該交付已透過特定專案管理軟體進行回報。專案經理接下來應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 檢視利害關係人參與計畫，並溝通有哪些技術可用於開發、傳輸和儲存專案產出物。
options_zh.B: 與軟體開發人員互動，讓他們使用該專案管理軟體，然後進行種子培訓活動以確保每個人都能使用它。
options_zh.C: 研究該專案管理軟體以了解其運作方式，並將其確立為存放專案產出物的可接受軟體。
options_zh.D: 檢視溝通管理計畫，並溝通應使用何種技術來開發、傳輸和儲存專案產出物。

What should the project manager do?

options.A: Let the developers focus on the refactoring work and discuss it in the retrospective
options.B: Restate to the developers the importance of focusing and meeting the sprint goal.
options.C: Praise the developers for their proactivity and focus on quality.
options.D: Escalate the issue to the developers' functional managers

question_text_zh: 在一個軟體開發專案中，產品負責人與開發團隊針對短衝待辦清單達成共識。待辦清單中最高優先順序的是建構付款模組。團隊在短衝的前半段致力於該模組，但現在有兩位開發人員希望在短衝的剩餘時間專注於重構另一個將來可能會產生問題的功能。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 讓開發人員專注於重構工作，並在回顧會議中進行討論
options_zh.B: 向開發人員重申專注並達成短衝目標的重要性
options_zh.C: 稱讚開發人員的主動性以及對品質的重視
options_zh.D: 將此問題呈報給開發人員的職能經理

question_text: During a kick-off meeting at the start of project execution, the vendor presents a migration plan to client stakeholders. The director of the business unit that owns the solution being migrated demands the ability to make the final go/no-go decision about whether the systems go live. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Schedule a meeting with the director to provide proof of expertise so the client stakeholders will trust the project team's decision.
options.B: Schedule a meeting with the project sponsor to determine if it is appropriate to accept the director's request to provide a decision.
options.C: Confirm with the director that the client stakeholders will be made accountable for the decision in the responsibility assignment matrix (RAM).
options.D: Ask the client to initiate a change request to make the director accountable for the decision.

options_list.text: Schedule a meeting with the director to provide proof of expertise so the client stakeholders will trust the project team's decision.
Schedule a meeting with the project sponsor to determine if it is appropriate to accept the director's request to provide a decision.

Ask the client to initiate a change request to make the director accountable for the decision.

question_text_zh: 在專案執行初期的專案啟動會議上，供應商向客戶利害關係人展示移轉計畫。擁有該移轉解決方案的業務單位處長要求擁有系統是否上線的最終決策權（go/no-go 決策）。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 安排與該處長的會議以提供專業能力證明，使客戶利害關係人信任專案團隊的決策。
options_zh.B: 安排與專案贊助者的會議，以評估接受該處長擁有決策權的要求是否合適。
options_zh.C: 向處長確認客戶利害關係人將在責任指派矩陣（RAM）中對該決策當責。
options_zh.D: 請客戶提出變更請求，使該處長對該決策當責。

options_zh.D: 為該團隊成員安排在下一個工作天的會議。

options_zh.C: 將該開發人員調到其他團隊，並尋找替代的開發人員。
options_zh.D: 要求將所有的品質保證任務都分配給新資源。

question_text_zh: 由於最近的公司合併，來自 B 公司的專案經理被指派到一個由 A 公司成員組成的團隊。在專案開始時，由於流程缺乏明確性以及專案經理與 B 公司的關係，引發了衝突。專案經理應該做什麼來解決這項衝突？

options_zh.B: 審查歷史資訊並根據投資報酬率（ROI）做出決策
options_zh.C: 要求團隊使用 B 公司的流程，因為他們對這些流程較為熟悉
options_zh.D: 與團隊合作分析適合採用的流程，並將其定義在基本規則中

question_text_zh: 高階管理團隊成員聯絡敏捷專案領導者，並提及該高階主管原以為會包含在當前發行版本中的某些功能並未納入。敏捷專案領導者應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 向高階主管保證這些功能將會排入下一個短衝中
options_zh.B: 與團隊會面以了解為何未包含該高階主管所需的功能
options_zh.C: 邀請該高階主管參加下一次規劃會議
options_zh.D: 將產品藍圖發送給該高階主管

How should the project manager ensure that the client is effectively represented in the daily meetings?

options.A: Recommend agile training programs that best suit the client project manager's schedule.
options.B: Realign the project to a predictive approach to ensure optimal collaboration between the teams.
options.C: Propose a session tor essential agile Knowledge transfer for the client team to align with the daily meeting goals
options.D: Provide the client project manager with agile best practice documents and web resources.

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.5 / 2.7 / 2.8 採購、品質與時程
concept_tag: 供應商與廠商管理 (Vendor Management)
question_text_zh: 設備廠商將為客戶公司導入一條新生產線。這項為期一年的專案將包含 2 到 4 個月長的疊代；然而，客戶的專案經理沒有敏捷經驗。專案經理應如何確保客戶在每日會議中得到有效代表？

options_zh.A: 推薦最適合客戶專案經理時程的敏捷培訓課程
options_zh.B: 將專案調整為預測型方法，以確保團隊間的最佳協作
options_zh.C: 為客戶團隊提議進行必要的敏捷知識轉移會議，以與每日會議目標保持一致
options_zh.D: 向客戶專案經理提供敏捷最佳實踐文件和網路資源

question_text: A medium-sized company has been exploring new marketing tactics with regard to launching a new product. New product creation is no small task. options.A: Make use of kanban boards so all stakeholders have a clear view of the project and provide their help accordingly.
options.B: Increase the contingency reserve and prepare the team for applying fast-failing techniques when the estimates veer from the initial plan.
options.C: Adopt a chain management approach, developing products based on the same platform and infrastructure.
options.D: Train the team to first find the minimum viable product (MVP) that will deliver value to the customer.

chapter_tag: 03. 定義範疇、價值和成功準則 (WBS、待辦清單、允收準則、MVP)

options_zh.A: 利用看板讓所有利害關係人對專案有清晰的了解，並相應地提供協助
options_zh.B: 增加應變準備金，並讓團隊做好在估算偏離最初計畫時應用快速失敗技術的準備
options_zh.C: 採用鏈式管理方法，在相同的平台與基礎架構上開發產品
options_zh.D: 培訓團隊首先找出能為客戶帶來價值的最小可行產品（MVP）

options_zh.A: 針對任務需求提供明確的期望
options_zh.B: 定期與團隊審查任務清單
options_zh.C: 提供範本供產品負責人日後使用
options_zh.D: 與贊助者一起審查該任務以確認其是否滿意

options.A: Collaborate with the change control board (CCB) to review the scope and submit any change requests
options.B: Submit a change request to the CCB and update the schedule
options.C: Update the scope and add more resources to the project
options.D: Update the scope and move on to the next project milestone

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)
eco_task_tag: ECO 3.3 / 3.4 / 3.5 風險、變更與障礙議題
concept_tag: 整合變更管制與 CCB (Change Control & CCB)
question_text_zh: 某公司最近使用次級研究（桌上研究）進行可行性研究，結果顯示專案進度落後。專案團隊也對範疇變更對專案時程的影響感到擔憂。專案經理應如何做才能使專案維持在時程內，同時仍能符合專案目標？

options_zh.A: 與變更管制委員會（CCB）協作審查範疇並提出任何變更請求
options_zh.B: 向 CCB 提出變更請求並更新時程
options_zh.C: 更新範疇並為專案增加更多資源
options_zh.D: 更新範疇並推進到下一個專案里程碑

question_text: A new team member joins an agile team. In a previous role, this team member was a subject matter expert (SME). This team member often directs the team on how to solve problems based on previous experience. What should the project manager do first?

options.A: Update the definition of done (DoD) to include a review by the new team member to ensure the best outcome of each deliverable.
options.B: Ask the new team member to create a wiki that the rest of the team can reference in the future for all questions.
options.C: Ask the new team member to size all the stories in the backlog so that the rest of the team can focus on delivery.
options.D: Let the new team member know that even if they know the answer, it is better to give the team a chance to solve their own problems

eco_task_tag: ECO 2.2 / 2.3 / 3.2 範疇、價值與法規遵循
concept_tag: 完成的定義 (DoD)
question_text_zh: 一位新團隊成員加入了敏捷團隊。在先前的職位中，該成員是主題專家（SME）。這位團隊成員經常根據過往經驗指導團隊如何解決問題。專案經理首先應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 更新完成的定義（DoD），納入由新團隊成員進行審查，以確保每個交付標的都有最佳成果
options_zh.B: 請新團隊成員建立一個 Wiki，以便團隊其他成員日後在遇到所有問題時可以參考
options_zh.C: 請新團隊成員估算待辦清單中所有故事的規模，以便團隊其他成員能專注於交付
options_zh.D: 讓新團隊成員明白，即使他們知道答案，最好也給團隊一個自行解決問題的機會

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)

options_zh.A: 要求團隊領導者指派其他資源。
options_zh.B: 更新議題記錄簿。
options_zh.C: 將此納入風險登錄表。
options_zh.D: 將此議題向上呈報給職能經理。

options.A: Counsel both team members and caution them with a final warning.
options.B: Escalate the issue to the human resources (HR) manager before a larger problem develops.
options.C: Help cultivate self-awareness between the two team members through emotional intelligence (El).
options.D: Relocate the two project team members into different project teams.

question_text_zh: 在專案中工作的兩位專案團隊成員之間頻繁發生衝突。這對專案造成了負面衝擊。專案經理應如何處理此情況？

options_zh.A: 輔導這兩位團隊成員並給予最終警告。
options_zh.B: 在產生更大問題之前，將此議題向上呈報給人力資源（HR）經理。
options_zh.C: 透過情緒智商（EI）協助培養兩位團隊成員之間的自我意識。
options_zh.D: 將這兩位專案團隊成員重新調派至不同的專案團隊。

options.A: Implement daily standups where the team can share their impediments, risks, and issues.
options.B: Review the communications management plan and implement changes.
options.C: Schedule weekly risk review meetings with the team to review project risks and concerns.
options.D: Distribute a copy of the communications management plan to the scrum master.

options_zh.A: 實施每日站立會議，讓團隊可以分享他們的障礙、風險和議題。
options_zh.B: 審查溝通管理計畫並實施變更。
options_zh.C: 與團隊安排每週風險審查會議，以審查專案風險和疑慮。
options_zh.D: 將溝通管理計畫的副本分發給敏捷教練（Scrum Master）。

options.B: Develop protocols for resolving conflicts between team members
options.C: Obtain special expertise to advise the team members
options.D: Set up face-to-face meetings with project team members

options_list.text: Force the team members to work from one location.

options_zh.A: 強制團隊成員在同一地點工作。
options_zh.B: 制定用於解決團隊成員之間衝突的協議規則。
options_zh.C: 獲取特殊專業知識來為團隊成員提供建議。
options_zh.D: 安排專案團隊成員進行面對面會議。

options_zh.A: 確保產品負責人有機會向利害關係人進行專案審查報告。

options.B: Review the project charter to determine if the training is in scope and, if not, put in a change request.

options_zh.A: 指出新技術的培訓是職能經理的職責。
options_zh.B: 審查專案章程以確認培訓是否在範疇內，若不在範疇內，則提出變更請求。
options_zh.C: 與組織變革管理專家諮詢培訓計畫包含的內容。
options_zh.D: 記錄該產品的技能要求，以確定需要何種培訓。

options_zh.A: 申請預算來獎勵該團隊成員，以便其他人有動力取得相同的認證。
options_zh.B: 將該團隊成員晉升為產品負責人，以便向客戶運用新知識。
options_zh.C: 向在此專案中開始使用該新工具的團隊成員提供激勵措施。
options_zh.D: 請該團隊成員運用其新獲得的知識，為團隊制定並提供培訓。

question_text_zh: 一家公司決定啟動一個專案，以淘汰過去 3 年來一直處於虧損狀態的銷售管道。專案團隊中的部分成員對該專案持悲觀態度。在這種情況下，專案經理應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 敦促職能經理直接向團隊成員說明專案的影響。
options_zh.B: 就專案目標和任務向團隊成員提供具體且明確的指引。
options_zh.C: 溝通專案的影響，並擬定在整個專案過程中使團隊成員持續參與的計畫。
options_zh.D: 呈報團隊的疑慮，並要求專案贊助者調整團隊成員組成。

question_text: A project manager is leading a project that is at 90% completion. One of the key stakeholders requests a certification program to be included as part of the project. Another stakeholder disagrees and informs the project team that there should be no change to the project management plan since the project is nearing completion. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Update the project management plan and adjust the project budget with this change request.
options.B: Raise a change request to the change control board (CCB) and inform the project sponsor about the change.
options.C: Ask the key stakeholder to take the lead in handling the request since they are more knowledgeable.
options.D: Request a meeting with the stakeholders and their team members to inform them about this change.

options_list.text: Update the project management plan and adjust the project budget with this change request.
Raise a change request to the change control board (CCB) and inform the project sponsor about the change.
Ask the key stakeholder to take the lead in handling the request since they are more knowledgeable.
Request a meeting with the stakeholders and their team members to inform them about this change.

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)

concept_tag: 專案管理計畫書 (Project Management Plan)
question_text_zh: 一位專案經理正在領導一個完成度已達 90% 的專案。其中一位關鍵利害關係人要求將一項認證計畫納入專案的一部分。另一位利害關係人表示反對，並告知專案團隊，由於專案已接近尾聲，不應對專案管理計畫進行任何變更。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 更新專案管理計畫，並配合此變更請求調整專案預算。
options_zh.B: 向變更管制委員會（CCB）提出變更請求，並向專案贊助者回報該變更。
options_zh.C: 請該關鍵利害關係人主導處理此請求，因為他們具備更多專業知識。
options_zh.D: 要求與利害關係人及其團隊成員召開會議，以告知他們此項變更。

options.D: Gather requirements from stakeholders

options_zh.A: 開始發展商業論證。
options_zh.B: 開始進行優勢、劣勢、機會與威脅（SWOT）分析。
options_zh.C: 與利害關係人互動並分配資源
options_zh.D: 收集利害關係人的需求

options.B: Request additional budget for contingency.
options.C: Perform a risk identification process with the project team.

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)

question_text_zh: 專案經理被指派負責一個長期專案。專案經理偶然得知政府正在就一項可能影響該專案的新法案進行辯論。專案經理首先應執行的兩項行動為何？（選擇兩項）

options_zh.A: 建立變更請求以與變更管制委員會（CCB）討論。
options_zh.B: 申請額外的應變預算。
options_zh.C: 與專案團隊一起執行風險識別流程。
options_zh.D: 諮詢專案利害關係人。
options_zh.E: 與主題專家（SME）討論可能的影響。

question_text: A project team that is very experienced in enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems implementation is currently planning the delivery of a new ERP project. There is a requirement to reuse the client's security subsystem developed by a third party. The client states that integration with the security subsystem must be done by the client's team. The project manager does not want to have such an external dependency. What should the project manager do first?

options.A: Plan the implementation of this integration in the first iteration to help reduce risks.
options.B: Record the issue in the issue log and closely manage this dependency.
options.C: Inform the client that the project team will take care of the integration.
options.D: Document the client's responsibility for the integration with the security subsystem.

options_list.text: Plan the implementation of this integration in the first iteration to help reduce risks.
Record the issue in the issue log and closely manage this dependency.
Inform the client that the project team will take care of the integration.
Document the client's responsibility for the integration with the security subsystem.

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)

question_text_zh: 一個在企業資源規劃（ERP）系統建置方面非常有經驗的專案團隊，目前正在規劃交付一個新的 ERP 專案。專案有一項需求是重用由第三方開發的客戶安全子系統。客戶表示與該安全子系統的整合必須由客戶的團隊進行。專案經理不希望有這樣的外部相依性。專案經理首先應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 在第一次反覆中規劃實施此整合，以協助降低風險。
options_zh.B: 將此議題記錄在議題記錄簿中，並嚴密管理此相依性。
options_zh.C: 通知客戶專案團隊將負責處理整合工作。
options_zh.D: 記錄客戶對於與安全子系統整合的責任。

(Choose two)

options.A: A lot of discussions that yield no results or possibly too many results
options.B: A lack of direction and motivation for the team in the workshop
options.C: Lessons learned from other teams to not be considered
options.D: Time management plan for the retrospective workshop to not be updated
options.E: A focus on the negative and a disinterest in further improvements

chapter_tag: 06. 溝通與知識傳遞 (溝通管理、資訊發布器、經驗學習)

options_zh.A: 產生大量討論卻毫無結果，或者可能產生過多的結果
options_zh.B: 團隊在工作坊中缺乏方向與動力
options_zh.C: 來自其他團隊的經驗學習未被納入考量
options_zh.D: 回顧會議工作坊的時間管理計畫未被更新
options_zh.E: 聚焦於負面事物並對進一步改善失去興趣

question_text: A project stakeholder has left the company. The new stakeholder is a family member of one of the team members. This stakeholder does not attend meetings. options.A: Design an updated status report.
options.B: Request a meeting with the stakeholder.
options.C: Escalate this to the project sponsor.
options.D: Forward the project status reports.

options_zh.A: 採購用於網路通話時消耗較少頻寬的工具。
options_zh.B: 錄製會議內容，以分享給無法加入的團隊成員。
options_zh.C: 要求團隊成員使用通訊軟體聊天工具作為通話的替代方案。
options_zh.D: 確認問題所在並制定行動計畫。

What should the project manager do next?

options.A: As the CPI and SPI are greater than 1.0, reevaluate and prioritize the remaining actions.
options.B: Stop the work and raise a project change request to the change control board (CCB) for additional funds and a project schedule extension.
options.C: As the cost performance index (CPI) and schedule performance index (SPI) are less than 1.0, reevaluate and prioritize the remaining actions.
options.D: Complete all actions and then inform the client of the additional cost and schedule overrun needed to complete the project.

concept_tag: 應變儲備 (Contingency Reserve)
question_text_zh: 專案經理獲得了關鍵的 5 天時間窗口，並被分配最多 100,000 美元作為應變儲備。隨後，專案經理根據現有的最佳資訊擬定了一套行動方案。總體而言，需要完成 5 項行動，每項成本為 20,000 美元，工期各為 1 天。經過 3 天的工作後，專案經理完成了兩項行動並花費了 80,000 美元。專案經理接下來應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 由於 CPI 和 SPI 大於 1.0，重新評估剩餘行動並排定優先順序。
options_zh.B: 停止工作，並向變更管制委員會（CCB）提出專案變更請求以申請額外資金與專案時程展延。
options_zh.C: 由於成本績效指標（CPI）和時程績效指標（SPI）小於 1.0，重新評估剩餘行動並排定優先順序。
options_zh.D: 完成所有行動，然後通知客戶完成專案所需的額外成本與時程超支。

options.D: Pair senior engineers to shadow the junior engineers and correct them throughout.

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)

question_text_zh: 一位專案經理正在與幾位初級工程師一起執行專案。專案經理注意到，當被問及問題時，初級工程師會推給團隊中更資深的成員來回答。由於曾與這些初級工程師在另一個專案中共事過，專案經理知道他們有能力正確做出這些次要決定。初級工程師的這種不確定感現在正在拖慢進度。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 更新風險名冊以反映專案進度變慢的可能影響。
options_zh.B: 確保初級工程師在一定的職責範圍內做出決策並對其承諾承擔。

options_zh.D: 安排資深工程師全程觀摩初級工程師並進行糾正。

options_zh.A: 讓團隊諮詢法規遵循專案負責人（compliance officer），以更新過去短衝中使用者故事的完成定義（DoD）。

options_zh.D: 安排顧問召開會議，為利害關係人提供敏捷實踐做法的培訓。

question_text_zh: 一位專案經理在試產階段中途被指派負責一項汽車產品開發專案。根據測試實驗室的說法，6週前完成了一項耐久性測試且結果良好，但上個月離職的測試工程師並未留下任何報告。前任專案經理應該採取什麼措施來預防此問題？

options_zh.A: 建立結對工程環境，讓資深工程師始終與初級工程師協同工作，以協助知識轉移

question_text_zh: 專案經理所在的公司正在執行一項營建專案。由於利害關係人之間反覆出現衝突與誤解，專案停滯不前。專案經理應該怎麼做以確保專案能順利啟動與完成？

options_zh.A: 進行現場勘查，立即啟動專案以避免不當延誤，並確保成本在控制之中
options_zh.B: 邀請所有利害關係人參加變更管制委員會 (CCB) 會議，分享回饋與事實，並達成共識。
options_zh.C: 鑑於利害關係人之間的誤解及相關風險，建議公司取消專案。
options_zh.D: 找出誤解的根本原因，促使各方達成共識，並協助落實成果。

question_text: A project manager has been assigned to an important project that will help set the future of the company. Meanwhile, the project management office (PMO) is implementing adaptive tools in a mostly predictive environment and has requested that the project manager follow this process as well. However, the functional manager has expressed concerns about the use of new tools on such an important project. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Review the adaptive tools' impact and obtain agreement from the functional manager. IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 113
options.B: Follow the functional manager's recommendation to implement only predictive tools in the project.
options.C: Make the decision on which project approach to use that would best fit the project.
options.D: Follow the project management office's (PMOs) request to implement the adaptive tools in the project.

options_list.text: Review the adaptive tools' impact and obtain agreement from the functional manager. IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 113
Follow the functional manager's recommendation to implement only predictive tools in the project.
Make the decision on which project approach to use that would best fit the project.
Follow the project management office's (PMOs) request to implement the adaptive tools in the project.

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)
eco_task_tag: PMP 基礎、敏捷宣言與生命週期裁適
concept_tag: 專案管理辦公室類型 (PMO Types)
question_text_zh: 一位專案經理被指派負責一項將有助於確定公司未來走向的重要專案。與此同時，專案管理辦公室 (PMO) 正在以預測型為主的環境中導入調適型工具，並要求專案經理也遵循此流程。然而，職能經理對在如此重要的專案上使用新工具表示擔憂。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 審查調適型工具的影響，並徵得職能經理的同意。
options_zh.B: 遵循職能經理的建議，在專案中僅採用預測型工具。
options_zh.C: 自行決定最適合專案的方法。
options_zh.D: 遵循專案管理辦公室 (PMO) 的要求，在專案中導入調適型工具。

question_text: A project manager works in a hierarchical organization. The project team members are used to being told what to do, and the performance reviews include the percentage of completion of the allocated tasks. After a conversation with the sponsor, the project manager realizes that they need to reassign a couple of tasks to meet the next milestone. This change can be perceived as poor performance by the current assignees. What should the project manager do?

options.A: 0Organize a team meeting and inform the team members that, as the person accountable for delivery, they decided to change the task allocation.
options.B: Ask the less experienced team member privately to stop working on the task and inform another team member that the work has been reassigned.
options.C: Ask the more experienced team member privately to take the task and inform the other team members that work has been reassigned.
options.D: Organize a team meeting to inform team members about a change in direction and work with them to change the task allocation.

options_list.text: 0Organize a team meeting and inform the team members that, as the person accountable for delivery, they decided to change the task allocation.
Ask the less experienced team member privately to stop working on the task and inform another team member that the work has been reassigned.
Ask the more experienced team member privately to take the task and inform the other team members that work has been reassigned.
Organize a team meeting to inform team members about a change in direction and work with them to change the task allocation.

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 發展整合專案計畫與基礎
concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 一位專案經理在階層式組織中工作。專案團隊成員習慣聽從指示行事，績效評估包含所分配任務的完成百分比。在與贊助者對話後，專案經理意識到需要重新分配幾項任務以達成下一個里程碑。此項變動可能會被原承辦人員視為績效不佳的表現。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 召開團隊會議，告知團隊成員身為負責交付的人員，他們決定更改任務分配。
options_zh.B: 私下要求經驗較少的團隊成員停止處理該任務，並通知另一位團隊成員工作已被重新分配。
options_zh.C: 私下要求經驗較豐富的團隊成員接手該任務，並通知其他團隊成員工作已被重新分配。
options_zh.D: 召開團隊會議，向團隊成員說明方向的改變，並與他們共同協商調整任務分配。

question_text: An external project manager is managing the construction of new corporate offices for a large company The project management plan states that it is necessary to contract a highly trained external resource to revise and validate an important project component The client has rejected hiring the external resource because of the high cost even though it is within the project budget. What should the project manager do to resolve this issue?

options.A: Hire the resource in order to achieve the project objectives.
options.B: Ask the client for a meeting and explain that the task will not be performed
options.C: Evaluate the consequences and meet with the client to explain the possible scenarios.
options.D: Try to accomplish the task internally by leveling resources from other projects

options_list.text: Hire the resource in order to achieve the project objectives.
Ask the client for a meeting and explain that the task will not be performed
Evaluate the consequences and meet with the client to explain the possible scenarios.
Try to accomplish the task internally by leveling resources from other projects

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 / 2.4 / 2.6 整合計畫、資源與財務
concept_tag: 專案管理計畫書 (Project Management Plan)
question_text_zh: 一位外部專案經理正在為一家大公司管理新企業辦公室的建造工程。專案管理計畫指出，有必要聘請高素質的外部資源來審查和驗證一項重要的專案組件。儘管該費用在專案預算範圍內，客戶仍以費用過高為由拒絕聘請該外部資源。專案經理應該做什麼來解決這個問題？

options_zh.A: 直接聘用該資源以實現專案目標。
options_zh.B: 請求與客戶開會，並說明該任務將不會被執行
options_zh.C: 評估其後果並與客戶會面，說明可能出現的情況。
options_zh.D: 嘗試透過平衡其他專案的資源來在內部完成該任務

options.A: Organize a meeting with the team and update the work breakdown structure (WBS).
options.B: Raise this issue, and review and update the progress report for the next monthly project IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 114 meeting.
options.C: Start the organization's change control process via a change request.
options.D: Communicate with an officer in the environmental protection department to check if it is necessary.

options_list.text: Organize a meeting with the team and update the work breakdown structure (WBS).
Raise this issue, and review and update the progress report for the next monthly project IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 114 meeting.
Start the organization's change control process via a change request.
Communicate with an officer in the environmental protection department to check if it is necessary.

options_zh.A: 與團隊召開會議並更新工作分解結構 (WBS)。
options_zh.B: 提出此議題，並審查及更新下個月專案會議的進度報告。
options_zh.C: 透過變更申請啟動組織的變更管制流程。
options_zh.D: 與環境保護部門的官員溝通，以確認是否有其必要性。

question_text_zh: 一名團隊成員正在舉辦一場活動，並透過工作行事曆邀請了幾位同事。另一名未受邀參加該活動的團隊成員，在幾次站立會議中明顯心不在焉。專案經理應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 要求舉辦活動的人員使用私人通訊方式。
options_zh.B: 與心不在焉的團隊成員安排一對一會議以討論任何問題。
options_zh.C: 在專案章程中增設社交活動章節以處理這些情況。
options_zh.D: 要求舉辦活動的人員將其活動標記為私人活動。

question_text: An agile team is making infrastructure changes to the human resources (HR) application system. Conflicting requirements are being submitted by various stakeholders. What should the project manager do to help move the project forward?

options.A: Review documents provided by other teams, such as lessons learned and the risk matrix.
options.B: Attend the Scrum of Scrums to identify roadblocks and manage dependencies.
options.C: Study the technology to assist the team in decision-making if progress slows.
options.D: Encourage the stakeholders to collaborate by facilitating meetings and sharing knowledge.

options_list.text: Review documents provided by other teams, such as lessons learned and the risk matrix.

question_text_zh: 一個敏捷團隊正在對人力資源（HR）應用系統進行基礎架構變更。各個利害關係人提出了相互衝突的需求。專案經理應該做什麼來協助推動專案進行？

options_zh.A: 審查其他團隊提供的文件，例如經驗學習和風險矩陣。
options_zh.B: 參加多團隊Scrum會議（Scrum of Scrums）以識別障礙並管理相依性。
options_zh.C: 研究該技術，以便在進度緩慢時協助團隊進行決策。
options_zh.D: 透過引導會議和知識共享，鼓勵利害關係人進行協作。

question_text: At the end of a workshop to review project deliverables, a number of follow-up action items were generated. What should the project manager do next?

options.A: Defer all actions until the next workshop to keep the team focused on other higher priorities
options.B: Follow up on each item as soon as possible to ensure timely completion and report the status to management.
options.C: Review the critical path and update the project schedule with the newly identified tasks.
options.D: Prioritize the actions with the team, assign individuals who will be responsible for completion, and monitor progress.

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)

question_text_zh: 在審查專案交付標的的敏捷工作坊結束時，產生了許多後續待辦行動項目。專案經理接下來應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 將所有行動延後到下一次工作坊，以使團隊專注於其他更高優先順序的事項。
options_zh.B: 盡快跟進每個項目以確保及時完成，並向管理階層報告狀態。
options_zh.C: 審查關鍵要徑，並使用新識別的任務更新專案時程。
options_zh.D: 與團隊一起將行動設定優先順序，指派負責完成的個人，並監控進度。

options.A: Help the team create the definition of done (DoD) to improve delivery quality.
options.B: Add testing items to the backlog to assess quality periodically.
options.C: Expand the team in order to improve the quality of the project.
options.D: Compare the cost of improving quality against the cost of failure and adjust the budget.

question_text_zh: 在一次敏捷團隊回顧會議中，一名專案團隊成員提到程式碼品質正在下降，這可能會導致未來的重工隨著時間變得難以應付。專案經理應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 協助團隊建立完成的定義（DoD）以提升交付品質。
options_zh.B: 將測試項目新增至待辦清單中，以定期評估品質。
options_zh.C: 擴充團隊規模以提高專案品質。
options_zh.D: 比較提升品質的成本與失敗成本，並調整預算。

options.A: Implement crashing to compress the schedule and improve the schedule performance index (SRI).
options.B: Implement fast-tracking to compress the schedule and improve the SPI
options.C: Perform conflict management using the project's resource management plan.
options.D: Review the risk management plan to evaluate the probability and impact of these delays

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)

question_text_zh: 在專案執行期間，專案經理注意到工作績效報告在不到兩週的時間內急遽惡化。A國的專案團隊抱怨因B國的國定假日而導致延誤，影響了他們的專案團隊。專案經理應該如何處理這種情況？

options_zh.A: 執行趕工以壓縮時程並提高時程績效指標（SPI）。
options_zh.B: 執行快速跟進以壓縮時程並提高SPI。
options_zh.C: 利用專案的資源管理計畫進行衝突管理。
options_zh.D: 檢視風險管理計畫以評估這些延誤的機率與衝擊。

question_text: During a regular review, the project manager of an agile project realizes that a key stakeholder is missing critical information about some features being developed. In order to improve communications and reduce the risk of deploying the wrong features, what should IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 127 the project manager do?

options.A: Assess the stakeholder's needs and communication style and propose a tailored approach with regular status reports and progress meetings.
options.B: Invite the stakeholder to the regular "show and tell" sessions so the stakeholder is aware of project progress and feedback can be gathered.
options.C: Conduct stakeholder remapping, evaluate stakeholders by their level of influence and interest on the project, and communicate accordingly.
options.D: Include the stakeholder on regular project communications so that decisions can be followed up closely.

options_list.text: Assess the stakeholder's needs and communication style and propose a tailored approach with regular status reports and progress meetings.

chapter_tag: 06. 溝通與知識傳遞 (溝通管理、資訊發布器、經驗學習)

concept_tag: 溝通管理計畫書與溝通方法 (Communication Management)
question_text_zh: 在一次定期審查中，敏捷專案的專案經理發現一位關鍵利害關係人遺漏了有關正在開發的某些功能的關鍵資訊。為了改善溝通並降低部署錯誤功能的風險，專案經理應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 評估該利害關係人的需求和溝通風格，並提出包含定期狀態報告和進度會議的客製化方法。
options_zh.B: 邀請該利害關係人參加定期的「展示與說明」（show and tell）展示會議，使該利害關係人了解專案進度並能收集回饋。
options_zh.C: 進行利害關係人重新對應分析，依據利害關係人對專案的影響力和利益程度進行評估，並據此進行溝通。
options_zh.D: 將該利害關係人納入常規專案溝通名單，以便密切跟進各項決策。

question_text: While managing a project using a hybrid approach, the project manager realizes that there is a high level of rework due to quality issues. Because of that, each feature is taking longer than initially estimated. What should the project manager do to address the issue?

options.A: Escalate the issue to the project sponsor.
options.B: Address the issue during the next sprint planning meeting.
options.C: Initiate a change request to extend the project end date.
options.D: Extend the dates for future project milestones.

options_zh.A: 將問題呈報給專案贊助者。
options_zh.B: 在下一次短衝規劃會議中處理該問題。
options_zh.C: 提出變更請求以延長專案結束日期。
options_zh.D: 延後未來專案里程碑的日期。

options_zh.A: 重新評估專案時程，因為速率將受到資源流失的影響。
options_zh.B: 與產品負責人重新評估待辦清單的優先順序，因為速率已受到影響。
options_zh.C: 重新評估當前迭代的範疇，以維持相同的速率與時程。
options_zh.D: 重新評估速率，因為迭代期間將受到新需求的影響。

options.D: Remove the certification need from the project scope.

options_zh.A: 將此事呈報給專案總監以尋求解決方案。
options_zh.B: 將此事呈報給第二個團隊的敏捷領導者。
options_zh.C: 檢視流程並排除障礙。
options_zh.D: 從專案範疇中移除認證需求。

A team member states that the deliverables were developed by experienced employees who confirmed that the project was stable. How should the new project manager address these concerns?

options.A: Allow the agile team to decide what they are able to deliver in each iteration
options.B: Ask the team for additional feedback and add tasks to the task board,
options.C: Hold a brainstorming session to identify the root cause of the complaints.
options.D: Document the customer's complaints and critical issues in the issue log.

question_text_zh: 在一次團隊會議中，新任敏捷專案經理得知客戶對專案穩定性及其他關鍵問題有許多抱怨。一名團隊成員表示，交付標的是由確認過專案穩定性的資深員工所開發。新專案經理應該如何處理這些疑慮？

options_zh.A: 允許敏捷團隊自行決定他們在每個迭代中能夠交付的內容。
options_zh.B: 向團隊徵詢更多回饋，並將任務新增至工作看板上。
options_zh.C: 舉行腦力激盪會議以找出抱怨的根本原因。
options_zh.D: 將客戶的抱怨和關鍵問題記錄在議題記錄簿中。

chapter_tag: 03. 定義範疇、價值和成功準則 (WBS、待辦清單、允收準則、MVP)

question_text_zh: 一個團隊已經在專案上工作了幾個月，但由於隨著獲得新知識而頻繁變更範疇，完成日期尚不明確。部分交付標的已經完成，但當新的利害關係人加入團隊時，他們抱怨專案成果未達到商業目標。專案經理未來如何預防這種情況發生？

options_zh.A: 建立依優先順序排序的待辦清單，並與利害關係人定義迭代審查會議。
options_zh.B: 建立經所有利害關係人核准的詳細工作分解結構（WBS）和里程碑時程表。
options_zh.C: 安排每日會議以審查團隊績效和障礙。
options_zh.D: 為每個專案階段安排啟動會議，與所有利害關係人分享專案管理計畫。

question_text: A junior project manager was recently hired to lead a complex project scheduled to kick off in 2 weeks. chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)

concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 一位初階專案經理最近被聘用來領導一個預計在兩週內啟動的複雜專案。這位初階專案經理被引薦給另一位專案經理接受指導。初階專案經理從導師指導中將獲得哪兩項好處？（選擇兩項）

options_zh.A: 初階專案經理在行政上向其導師報告，以便能夠快速回答人力資源（HR）相關問題。
options_zh.B: 初階專案經理可以與其導師討論特定問題，而不用擔心受到懲罰或報復。
options_zh.C: 如果發生問題或專案延誤，導師將隨時可以立即接管專案。
options_zh.D: 導師將參與初階專案經理所執行的決策流程。
options_zh.E: 導師可以提供過往專案文件，其中包含潛在問題可能發生的早期預警指標。

question_text: A project manager is leading a team of diverse individuals of all ages. options.A: Allow the most senior team members to decide the time that works for the team.
options.B: Reassess the team's hours collaboratively so that the team is not impeded by the issue.
options.C: Discuss the lack of dedication with the team member and their functional manager.
options.D: Remove the team member from the project team to be fair to the other members.

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 發展整合專案計畫與基礎
concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 一位專案經理正帶領著一個由不同年齡層組成的多元化團隊。專案的工作時間是在專案開始時設定的，且所有團隊成員都同意了該工作時間。然而，在專案後續進行中，其中一名團隊成員通知專案經理，由於該成員的個人承諾，先前商定的時間已不再適用。專案經理應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 允許最資深的團隊成員決定適合團隊的時間。
options_zh.B: 以協作方式重新評估團隊的工作時間，使團隊不受該問題的阻礙。

How should the project manager handle this issue?

options.A: Disregard these stakeholders since the relevant documents have been secured to execute this project.
options.B: Update the stakeholder register and risk management plan.
options.C: Update the stakeholder register and revise the stakeholder engagement plan.
options.D: Explain to the community members why they were not included as stakeholders for the project.

options_zh.A: 確保變更管理計畫強調此要求，以預防未來的問題。

question_text_zh: 某專案團隊正從預測型方法轉型至敏捷方法。專案經理正試圖盡量減少該產品在上線生產環境後所出現的支援問題。其中一個特別的痛點是向維運團隊移交的過程，問題通常發生於此。專案經理應該怎麼做來改善這種情況？

options_zh.A: 更加專注於涵蓋支援需求的待辦清單項目，以及產品手冊和作業指南。
options_zh.B: 要求支援／維運團隊參與每日站立會議，為專案進度做出貢獻。
options_zh.C: 讓維運團隊參與回顧會議和展示會議，並將他們的反饋納入專案活動中。
options_zh.D: 透過儘早讓利害關係人參與待辦清單討論，促進他們的投入。

question_text: A member of the board of directors is the sponsor of a project that is important to the organization This stakeholder has many other priorities and is not currently engaged in the project activities How should the stakeholder be engaged in the project?

options.A: Keep the stakeholder informed and consult with them based on their needs
options.B: Involve the stakeholder in governance and decision making
options.C: Consult with the stakeholder and increase their level of interest
options.D: The stakeholder needs to be made aware of the project progress

options_list.text: Keep the stakeholder informed and consult with them based on their needs
Involve the stakeholder in governance and decision making
Consult with the stakeholder and increase their level of interest
The stakeholder needs to be made aware of the project progress

chapter_tag: 02. 建立基礎—願景、利害關係人與治理 (專案章程、利害關係人參與、治理結構)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.1 / 1.4 / 3.1 願景、利害關係人與治理
concept_tag: 專案治理 (Project Governance)
question_text_zh: 某位董事會成員是對組織至關重要的一項專案的贊助者。這位利害關係人有許多其他優先要務，目前並未參與專案活動。應該如何讓該利害關係人參與專案？

options_zh.A: 保持該利害關係人的知情狀態，並根據其需求向其諮詢
options_zh.B: 讓該利害關係人參與治理與決策制定
options_zh.C: 向該利害關係人諮詢並提高其興趣程度
options_zh.D: 需要讓該利害關係人獲悉專案進度

question_text: The project manager of a high-risk project is concerned about a delay in the schedule that might force the project to 'move its go-live date. What should the project manager do next?

options.A: Ensure that the project meets the committed time lines as this is the core objective and purpose of the project.
options.B: Raise a change request to the change control board (CCB) to ask for funds to onboard new resources to expedite the project.
options.C: Capture the risk in the risk register and monitor it to prevent it from becoming an issue by taking the proper response action.
options.D: Ask the sponsor to start a new project to support the existing project and help it meet the original time line.

options_list.text: Ensure that the project meets the committed time lines as this is the core objective and purpose of the project.
Raise a change request to the change control board (CCB) to ask for funds to onboard new resources to expedite the project.
Capture the risk in the risk register and monitor it to prevent it from becoming an issue by taking the proper response action.
Ask the sponsor to start a new project to support the existing project and help it meet the original time line.

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)
eco_task_tag: ECO 3.3 / 3.4 / 3.5 風險、變更與障礙議題
concept_tag: 風險登錄表与風險評估 (Risk Register & Analysis)
question_text_zh: 某高風險專案的專案經理擔心進度延誤可能會迫使專案變更上線日期。專案經理接下來應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 確保專案符合承諾的時程，因為這是專案的核心目標與宗旨。
options_zh.B: 向變更管制委員會（CCB）提出變更申請，請求資金以引入新資源來加快專案進度。
options_zh.C: 將該風險記錄在風險登錄表中並進行監控，透過採取適當的因應措施來防止其演變成問題。
options_zh.D: 要求贊助者啟動一個新專案以支援現有專案，並協助其達成原定時程。

question_text: A project manager is beginning a new project with very diverse team members. The project IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 135 manager chose to use consensus building so the team can agree on and be engaged in how the project will be executed. How should the project manager proceed?

options.A: 0Create an environment where the agreement is reached by a majority vote.
options.B: Create an environment where the agreement is reached through discussion.
options.C: Establish recurring brainstorming sessions to discuss project issues.
options.D: Allow team members to contribute ideas in a stream-of-consciousness mode.

options_list.text: 0Create an environment where the agreement is reached by a majority vote.
Create an environment where the agreement is reached through discussion.
Establish recurring brainstorming sessions to discuss project issues.
Allow team members to contribute ideas in a stream-of-consciousness mode.

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 發展整合專案計畫與基礎
concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 專案經理正在啟動一個成員背景非常多元的新專案。專案經理選擇採用建立共識的方式，以便團隊能夠就專案如何執行達成一致並保持投入。專案經理應該如何進行？

options_zh.A: 營造一個透過多數決達成協議的環境。
options_zh.B: 營造一個透過充分討論達成協議的環境。
options_zh.C: 建立定期的腦力激盪會議來討論專案議題。
options_zh.D: 允許團隊成員以意識流模式提出想法。

question_text: A project's customer is furious. When the customer arrived at the project site, they discovered that one of their requirements was not met. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Refer to the requirements traceability matrix and analyze the requirement.
options.B: Analyze the benefits management plan and implement the needed change.
options.C: Consult the scope management plan with the customer to understand the gap.
options.D: Discuss and agree with the customer to implement the missing requirement.

options_list.text: Refer to the requirements traceability matrix and analyze the requirement.
Analyze the benefits management plan and implement the needed change.
Consult the scope management plan with the customer to understand the gap.
Discuss and agree with the customer to implement the missing requirement.

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 / 2.4 / 2.6 整合計畫、資源與財務
concept_tag: 效益管理計畫書 (Benefits Management Plan)
question_text_zh: 專案的客戶非常憤怒。當客戶到達專案現場時，發現他們的其中一項需求未被滿足。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 查閱需求追蹤矩陣並分析該需求。
options_zh.B: 分析效益管理計畫並實施所需的變更。
options_zh.C: 與客戶共同查閱範疇管理計畫以了解差距。
options_zh.D: 與客戶討論並同意實施遺漏的需求。

question_text: A project manager is nearing completion of an automation project. One of the key stakeholders requests a meeting to discuss some new ideas that would make the project even more appealing to end users. As a result, the stakeholder suggests that the project manager does not close the project. What should the project manager do first?

options.A: Update the project charter with the new requirement.
options.B: Add a risk to the risk register.
options.C: Add it to the issue log as an ongoing issue.
options.D: Review and validate the scope management plan.

options_list.text: Update the project charter with the new requirement.
Add a risk to the risk register.
Add it to the issue log as an ongoing issue.
Review and validate the scope management plan.

chapter_tag: 02. 建立基礎—願景、利害關係人與治理 (專案章程、利害關係人參與、治理結構)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.1 / 1.4 / 3.1 願景、利害關係人與治理
concept_tag: 專案章程 (Project Charter)
question_text_zh: 專案經理即將完成一個自動化專案。其中一位關鍵利害關係人要求開會討論一些新構想，這些構想能讓專案對最終使用者更具吸引力。因此，該利害關係人建議專案經理不要結束專案。專案經理首先應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 使用新需求更新專案章程。
options_zh.B: 在風險登錄表中新增一項風險。
options_zh.C: 將其作為進行中的議題加入議題記錄中。
options_zh.D: 審查並確認範疇管理計畫。

question_text: An issue reoccurs six months after a project's go-live date despite being resolved during the project life cycle. What should the project manager have done in the previous phase to avoid this issue?

options.A: Ensured the project team documented lessons learned about the issue
options.B: Ensured the project team applied a long-term solution for the issue
options.C: Asked the project team to conduct more testing with users
options.D: Discussed the issue with the stakeholders

options_list.text: Ensured the project team documented lessons learned about the issue
Ensured the project team applied a long-term solution for the issue
Asked the project team to conduct more testing with users
Discussed the issue with the stakeholders

chapter_tag: 06. 溝通與知識傳遞 (溝通管理、資訊發布器、經驗學習)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.7 / 1.8 溝通與知識傳遞
concept_tag: 經驗學習登錄表 (Lessons Learned Register)
question_text_zh: 儘管某個議題在專案生命週期中已獲得解決，但在專案上線（Go-live）六個月後該議題又再次發生。專案經理在先前的階段應該做什麼以避免此議題？

options_zh.A: 確保專案團隊記錄了有關該議題的經驗學習。
options_zh.B: 確保專案團隊針對該議題採用了長期解決方案。
options_zh.C: 要求專案團隊與使用者進行更多測試。
options_zh.D: 與利害關係人討論該議題。

question_text: A key stakeholder is upset because the final product delivery has been postponed for the third time. The project manager meets with the stakeholder and discovers that there is a risk of revenue impact if a new feature is not released in 1 month. IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 136 What should the project manager do?

options.A: Inform the stakeholder that the new requirement will be considered in the next release planning session.
options.B: Inform the sponsor of the latest changes and ask the sponsor to prioritize the features.
options.C: Ask the product owner to determine if this requirement needs to be treated as a top priority.
options.D: Direct the development team to work on this requirement right away.

options_list.text: Inform the stakeholder that the new requirement will be considered in the next release planning session.
Inform the sponsor of the latest changes and ask the sponsor to prioritize the features.
Ask the product owner to determine if this requirement needs to be treated as a top priority.
Direct the development team to work on this requirement right away.

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)
eco_task_tag: ECO 3.3 / 3.4 / 3.5 風險、變更與障礙議題
concept_tag: 專案風險管理 (Project Risk Management)
question_text_zh: 一位關鍵利害關係人感到不滿，因為最終產品交付已經第三次被延期。專案經理與該利害關係人會面後發現，如果某項新功能未在 1 個月內發布，將存在影響營收的風險。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 告知利害關係人該新需求將在下一次發布規劃會議中考慮。
options_zh.B: 將最新變更告知贊助者，並請贊助者排列功能優先順序。
options_zh.C: 請產品負責人判定此需求是否需要列為最高優先級。
options_zh.D: 指示開發團隊立即著手處理該需求。

question_text: A team needs to implement a mandatory compliance regulation in a product, which is required for its release. While nearing the product release, when completeness was being verified, it was found that the compliance part was not implemented in the project. What should the project manager do next?

options.A: Get an exception approval from the legal team.
options.B: Request the team to implement the compliance.
options.C: Ask the stakeholder to descope the compliance.
options.D: Obtain approval from management and release.

options_list.text: Get an exception approval from the legal team.
Request the team to implement the compliance.
Ask the stakeholder to descope the compliance.
Obtain approval from management and release.

chapter_tag: 03. 定義範疇、價值和成功準則 (WBS、待辦清單、允收準則、MVP)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.2 / 2.3 / 3.2 範疇、價值與法規遵循
concept_tag: 法規遵循 (Compliance)
question_text_zh: 團隊需要在產品中落實一項發布前必須滿足的強制性法規遵循要求。在接近產品發布、驗證完整性時，發現專案中並未實施該法規遵循部分。專案經理下一步應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 從法務團隊取得例外核准。
options_zh.B: 要求團隊落實該法規遵循要求。
options_zh.C: 要求利害關係人將法規遵循移出範疇。
options_zh.D: 取得管理階層核准並予以發布。

question_text: One of the key stakeholders on the project team reaches out with an additional requirement that may impact the overall schedule. A discussion with another stakeholder suggests thai this might just be a small task. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Coordinate design document preparation (B). Perform a qualitative risk analysis
options.C: Request further clarification of the requirement
options.D: Manage the engagement of this stakeholder.

options_list.text: Coordinate design document preparation (B). Perform a qualitative risk analysis
Request further clarification of the requirement
Manage the engagement of this stakeholder.

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)
eco_task_tag: ECO 3.3 / 3.4 / 3.5 風險、變更與障礙議題
concept_tag: 定性與定量風險分析 (Qualitative/Quantitative Risk)
question_text_zh: 專案團隊中的一位關鍵利害關係人提出了一項可能影響整體時程的額外需求。與另一位利害關係人討論後認為這可能只是一項小工作。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 協調設計文件的準備。
options_zh.B: 進行定性風險分析。
options_zh.C: 要求對該需求進行進一步釐清。
options_zh.D: 管理該利害關係人的參與。

question_text: A project team's performance has declined for the last three iterations Some of the team members are disappointed, and raise their concerns during the retrospective meeting What should the project manager do?

options.A: Focus on remediation not merely on correcting symptoms
options.B: Compare the team's performance against other project teams
options.C: Identify potential failure points based on the iteration workload
options.D: Motivate the team to perform better

options_list.text: Focus on remediation not merely on correcting symptoms
Compare the team's performance against other project teams
Identify potential failure points based on the iteration workload
Motivate the team to perform better

chapter_tag: 11. 推動持續與組織改善 (持續改善、精實/六標準差、回顧會議)
eco_task_tag: 持續改善與回顧 (Continuous Improvement)
concept_tag: 短衝回顧會議 (Sprint Retrospective)
question_text_zh: 一個專案團隊的績效在過去三個迭代中有所下滑。部分團隊成員感到失望，並在回顧會議中提出他們的疑慮。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 專注於根本矯正補救，而不僅僅是消除表面症狀。
options_zh.B: 將團隊績效與其他專案團隊進行比較。
options_zh.C: 根據迭代工作量識別潛在的失敗點。
options_zh.D: 激勵團隊以取得更好的表現。

question_text: In a time-critical construction project, a misunderstanding occurred between the supervisor and the technician The misunderstanding turned into a major conflict and the technician has IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 137 complained to the project manager that they cannot continue to work under the supervisor any longer. The supervisor cites the technicians poor performance as the reason for the conflict How should the project manager resolve the problem?

options.A: Talk to the supervisor to tone down their approach and attitude.
options.B: Provide a just-in-time training to the technician to improve their skill set.
options.C: Use a direct, collaborative approach with the technician and supervisor.
options.D: Replace the technician with a high performing resource as time is critical

options_list.text: Talk to the supervisor to tone down their approach and attitude.
Provide a just-in-time training to the technician to improve their skill set.
Use a direct, collaborative approach with the technician and supervisor.
Replace the technician with a high performing resource as time is critical

chapter_tag: 07. 領導及賦能團隊 (衝突管理、僕人式領導、團隊發展階段、情商)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.2 / 1.3 管理衝突與領導團隊
concept_tag: 衝突管理策略 (Conflict Management)
question_text_zh: 在一個時間緊迫的營造專案中，主管與技術人員之間產生了誤會。該誤會演變成重大衝突，技術人員向專案經理抱怨無法再繼續在該主管底下工作。主管則指稱技術人員表現不佳是引發衝突的原因。專案經理應該如何解決這個問題？

options_zh.A: 與主管溝通，要求緩和其作風與態度。
options_zh.B: 向技術人員提供及時培訓以提升其技能。
options_zh.C: 與技術人員和主管共同採取直接、合作的方式處理。
options_zh.D: 鑑於時間緊迫，以高績效人員替換該技術人員。

question_text: A project manager for a maintenance project has a contract that is renewed annually The project started 6 years ago After contract renewal this year the auditors reported that this version of the contract violates a new law that was passed last year What has happened in this situation?

options.A: The contract has not been appropriately reviewed by the project team
options.B: The stakeholder engagement plan has not been correctly implemented
options.C: The legal department has not disseminated the law correctly to all staff.
options.D: The project manager does not have enough knowledge on this legal matter

options_list.text: The contract has not been appropriately reviewed by the project team
The stakeholder engagement plan has not been correctly implemented
The legal department has not disseminated the law correctly to all staff.
The project manager does not have enough knowledge on this legal matter

chapter_tag: 02. 建立基礎—願景、利害關係人與治理 (專案章程、利害關係人參與、治理結構)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.1 / 1.4 / 3.1 願景、利害關係人與治理
concept_tag: 利害關係人參與 (Stakeholder Engagement)
question_text_zh: 某維護專案的專案經理手頭有一份每年續約的合約。該專案始於 6 年前。今年續約後，稽核人員報告稱該版本合約違反了去年通過的一項新法律。在這種情況下發生了什麼事？

options_zh.A: 專案團隊未對合約進行適當審查。
options_zh.B: 利害關係人參與計畫未被正確執行。
options_zh.C: 法務部門未將法律正確宣導給所有員工。
options_zh.D: 專案經理對該法律事務缺乏足夠的知識。

question_text: A project manager is evaluating a project and realizes that its earned value (EV) shows the cost spent is higher than the value delivered. The project manager then discovers that the team has been adding small features that are not part of the requirements. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Ask the team to focus on and deliver only the agreed-upon features.
options.B: Request additional budget because additional features are being added.
options.C: Encourage the team to continue, as this will eventually help the customer.
options.D: Ask the product owner to add the additional features to the requirements.

options_list.text: Ask the team to focus on and deliver only the agreed-upon features.
Request additional budget because additional features are being added.
Encourage the team to continue, as this will eventually help the customer.
Ask the product owner to add the additional features to the requirements.

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 / 2.4 / 2.6 整合計畫、資源與財務
concept_tag: 專案預算與資金限制 (Project Budget)
question_text_zh: 專案經理正在評估專案，並發現其實獲值（EV）顯示所花費的成本高於所交付的價值。專案經理隨後發現團隊一直在增加不屬於需求範圍內的小功能。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 要求團隊集中精力並僅交付已達成共識的功能。
options_zh.B: 由於增加了額外功能，因此申請追加預算。
options_zh.C: 鼓勵團隊繼續進行，因為這最終將有助於客戶。
options_zh.D: 請產品負責人將額外功能加入需求中。

question_text: A complex project is m its execution phase. The project is set up to produce both predictive and incremental deliverables. question_text_zh: 營建工地的專案經理意識到利害關係人關係的重要性，尤其是與在地社區的關係。專案經理與專案團隊致力於與這些關鍵利害關係人建立良好關係，以防止未來出現阻礙。專案經理應該怎麼做來客製化利害關係人參與計畫？

options_zh.A: 分析社區中的利害關係人多元性。
options_zh.B: 評估與社區合作的需求。
options_zh.C: 分析與社區談判的需求。
options_zh.D: 評估社區的資訊需求。

question_text: A company is transitioning its projects from a predictive to an iterative approach. The protect team is complaining because they are unsure of what needs to be done due to all of the changes requested by the product owner for features already developed since the beginning of the project. How should the project manager handle this situation?

options.A: Ask the product owner to create a new entry in the risk management plan regarding likelihood and imped
options.B: Review the backlogs from similar projects and understand how change requests were implemented
options.C: Ask the product owner to follow the change request process to formalize new requirements
options.D: Make sure that the product and sprint backlogs have the required level of documentation and both are visible to the team

options_list.text: Ask the product owner to create a new entry in the risk management plan regarding likelihood and imped
Review the backlogs from similar projects and understand how change requests were implemented
Ask the product owner to follow the change request process to formalize new requirements
