chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)
eco_task_tag: ECO 3.3 / 3.4 / 3.5 風險、變更與障礙議題
concept_tag: 變更申請流程 (Change Request)
question_text_zh: 一家公司正在將其專案從預測型方法轉換為反覆型方法。專案團隊正在抱怨，因為產品負責人自專案開始以來不斷對已開發的功能提出變更要求，導致團隊不確定該做什麼。專案經理應該如何處理這種情況？

options_zh.A: 要求產品負責人在風險管理計畫中建立一筆關於可能性與衝擊的新條目。
options_zh.B: 審查類似專案的待辦清單，並了解變更請求是如何被實施的。
options_zh.C: 要求產品負責人遵循變更請求流程以將新需求正式化。
options_zh.D: 確保產品待辦清單與短衝待辦清單具備所需程度的文件說明，且兩者對團隊皆是可見的。

question_text: A food company is developing a new product using a predictive approach, and the product is currently in the testing phase Given the nature of the feedback of the tests, the project manager has decided to use an iterative approach At the end of one of the iterations, a new regulation related to the product is enacted. What should the project manager do next?

options.A: Make a change request regarding the project's scope to ensure compliance.
options.B: Include an assessment to verfy compliance in the next iteration
options.C: Conduct an iteration review to address the new regulation
options.D: Start the tests over, adapting the trials to the new regulation

options_list.text: Make a change request regarding the project's scope to ensure compliance.
Include an assessment to verfy compliance in the next iteration
Conduct an iteration review to address the new regulation
Start the tests over, adapting the trials to the new regulation

chapter_tag: 03. 定義範疇、價值和成功準則 (WBS、待辦清單、允收準則、MVP)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.2 / 2.3 / 3.2 範疇、價值與法規遵循
concept_tag: 法規遵循 (Compliance)
question_text_zh: 一家食品公司正在使用預測型方法開發一項新產品，該產品目前處於測試階段。鑑於測試反饋的性質，專案經理決定採用反覆型方法。在其中一個反覆迭代結束時，頒布了一項與該產品相關的新法規。專案經理下一步應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 針對專案範疇提出變更請求以確保合規性。
options_zh.B: 在下一次反覆迭代中納入驗證合規性的評估。
options_zh.C: 進行反覆迭代審查以因應新法規。
options_zh.D: 重新開始測試，使試驗適應新法規。

question_text: A new project manager has been assigned to a project that is in its second phase The product created in the first phase was transferred to operations During a meeting, the project sponsor complained that some of the reports contain conflicting data on the product value What should the new project manager do next?

options.A: Review the benefits management plan
options.B: Refer to the lessons learned from the first phase
options.C: Consult the project reports from the previous project manager
options.D: Collect information from related departments

options_list.text: Review the benefits management plan
Refer to the lessons learned from the first phase
Consult the project reports from the previous project manager
Collect information from related departments

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 / 2.4 / 2.6 整合計畫、資源與財務
concept_tag: 效益管理計畫書 (Benefits Management Plan)
question_text_zh: 一位新專案經理被指派負責一個處於第二階段的專案。在第一階段建立的產品已移轉至營運部門。在一次會議中，專案贊助者抱怨某些報告中包含關於產品價值的相互衝突數據。新專案經理下一步應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 審查效益管理計畫。
options_zh.B: 參考第一階段的經驗學習。
options_zh.C: 查閱前任專案經理的專案報告。
options_zh.D: 從相關部門收集資訊。

question_text: In the past, the project manager and the project team performed well using predictive IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 152 methodology. However, the organization recently decided to adopt agile approaches, and the project sponsor wants to use an agile approach in an upcoming project. Before initiating the project, what should the project manager do?

options.A: Prepare a risk report that captures the probability and impact of risks, and then share it with the project sponsor.
options.B: Share the organization's decision with the team and make plans to adopt an agile approach in the upcoming project.
options.C: Make a request to human resources for new team members who have agile experience.
options.D: Ask the project sponsor to change the approach back to predictive as that is the team's strength.

options_list.text: Prepare a risk report that captures the probability and impact of risks, and then share it with the project sponsor.
Share the organization's decision with the team and make plans to adopt an agile approach in the upcoming project.
Make a request to human resources for new team members who have agile experience.
Ask the project sponsor to change the approach back to predictive as that is the team's strength.

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)
eco_task_tag: ECO 3.3 / 3.4 / 3.5 風險、變更與障礙議題
concept_tag: 專案風險管理 (Project Risk Management)
question_text_zh: 過去，專案經理和專案團隊在使用預測型方法時表現良好。然而，組織最近決定採用敏捷方法，且專案贊助者希望在即將進行的專案中使用敏捷方法。在啟動專案之前，專案經理應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 準備一份記錄風險機率與衝擊的風險報告，然後與專案贊助者分享。
options_zh.B: 與團隊分享組織的決定，並擬定在即將進行的專案中採用敏捷方法的計畫。
options_zh.C: 向人力資源部門請求具備敏捷經驗的新團隊成員。
options_zh.D: 請求專案贊助者將方法改回預測型，因為那是團隊的強項。

question_text: A project manager notices that a project participant seems frustrated and expresses themselves loudly at status meetings and later discovers that the participant is hearing impaired. Which process should the project manager have used at the start of the protect that would have identified this situation?

options.A: Stakeholder analysis
options.B: Resource needs analysis
options.C: Accommodations assessment
options.D: Team member assessment

options_list.text: Stakeholder analysis
Resource needs analysis
Accommodations assessment
Team member assessment

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 發展整合專案計畫與基礎
concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 專案經理注意到一位專案參與者在狀況會議上顯得很沮喪且大聲表達意見，後來發現該參與者有聽力障礙。專案經理在專案開始時應該使用哪一項流程，就能識別出這種情況？

options_zh.A: 利害關係人分析
options_zh.B: 資源需求分析
options_zh.C: 通融設施評估
options_zh.D: 團隊成員評估

question_text: A project manager received the project charter for a new product. The project is expected to have two main deliveries: the hardware part that has detailed specifications already defined, including a sample machine, and the user interface software that has only a basic specification and a requirement for a user experience design approach. Which project management approach should the project manager use?

options.A: The software development has a high uncertainty level, so an agile approach is recommended for the project.
options.B: The scope is well defined; therefore, a predictive approach is straightforward and the hardware and software can by synchronized on the gates.
options.C: The deliverables are significantly different, so the project should be split into two projects that are driven by a program.
options.D: A hybrid approach will work, using agile for software development and a predictive approach for the hardware deliveries.

options_list.text: The software development has a high uncertainty level, so an agile approach is recommended for the project.
The scope is well defined; therefore, a predictive approach is straightforward and the hardware and software can by synchronized on the gates.
The deliverables are significantly different, so the project should be split into two projects that are driven by a program.
A hybrid approach will work, using agile for software development and a predictive approach for the hardware deliveries.

chapter_tag: 02. 建立基礎—願景、利害關係人與治理 (專案章程、利害關係人參與、治理結構)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.1 / 1.4 / 3.1 願景、利害關係人與治理
concept_tag: 專案章程 (Project Charter)
question_text_zh: 專案經理收到了新產品的專案章程。該專案預計有兩個主要交付項目：硬體部分已有明確定義的詳細規格，包含樣品機台；使用者介面軟體則僅有基本規格以及對使用者體驗設計方法的要求。專案經理應該使用哪種專案管理方法？

options_zh.A: 軟體開發具有高度不確定性，因此建議專案採用敏捷方法。
options_zh.B: 範疇定義明確；因此，預測型方法簡單直接，且硬體與軟體可以在檢驗點（關卡）進行同步。
options_zh.C: 交付標的差異顯著，因此專案應拆分為由大型計畫（Program）驅動的兩個專案。
options_zh.D: 混合型方法可行，軟體開發採用敏捷方法，硬體交付採用預測型方法。

question_text: A company that uses a predictive approach and operates in a highly regulated market is losing profitability because its product life cycle is taking longer than those of its competitors. A new project manager has been hired to change this scenario. What approach should the project manager propose?

options.A: Change to an agile model, focusing primarily on the incremental life cycle, leaving the IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 153 iterative approach as a next step.
options.B: Maintain a predictive approach, but increase the focus on better planning and tracking to anticipate problems and avoid delays.
options.C: Migrate to an agile model, focusing primarily on an iterative approach, leaving the incremental life cycle as a next step.
options.D: Propose a hybrid approach, leveraging the benefits of an agile approach while respecting some aspects of the company's industry.

options_list.text: Change to an agile model, focusing primarily on the incremental life cycle, leaving the IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 153 iterative approach as a next step.
Maintain a predictive approach, but increase the focus on better planning and tracking to anticipate problems and avoid delays.
Migrate to an agile model, focusing primarily on an iterative approach, leaving the incremental life cycle as a next step.
Propose a hybrid approach, leveraging the benefits of an agile approach while respecting some aspects of the company's industry.

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)
eco_task_tag: PMP 基礎、敏捷宣言與生命週期裁適
concept_tag: 混合型生命週期轉換 (Hybrid Approach)
question_text_zh: 一家採用預測型方法並在高度監管市場中營運的公司正逐漸失去獲利能力，因為其產品生命週期比競爭對手花費更長的時間。一位新聘用的專案經理被指派來扭轉此局勢。專案經理應該提出什麼方法？

options_zh.A: 轉換為敏捷模式，主要聚焦於增量型生命週期，並將反覆型方法作為下一步。
options_zh.B: 維持預測型方法，但加強聚焦於更好的規劃與追蹤，以預測問題並避免延誤。
options_zh.C: 遷移至敏捷模式，主要聚焦於反覆型方法，並將增量型生命週期作為下一步。
options_zh.D: 提出混合型方法，善用敏捷方法的優勢，同時兼顧公司所屬產業的特定面向。

question_text: A global petroleum crisis has affected the distribution of crude oil in the region where the construction project is underway Materials are not being delivered on time and this phase of construction is already behind for what was initially planned. What should the project manager do first to prevent the project from going further off track?

options.A: Perform a risk assessment and define a risk response action plan.
options.B: Proceed with the project using management reserves to cover any delays or losses.
options.C: Propose a pause in this phase to save labor costs and asset depreciation.
options.D: Establish new partnerships with other suppliers in anticipation of any delays.

options_list.text: Perform a risk assessment and define a risk response action plan.
Proceed with the project using management reserves to cover any delays or losses.
Propose a pause in this phase to save labor costs and asset depreciation.
Establish new partnerships with other suppliers in anticipation of any delays.

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 / 2.4 / 2.6 整合計畫、資源與財務
concept_tag: 管理儲備 (Management Reserve)
question_text_zh: 全球石油危機影響了營建專案所在區域的原油配送。材料無法按時交付，且此營建階段已經落後於最初計畫。為了防止專案進一步偏離軌道，專案經理首先應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 執行風險評估並定義風險因應行動計畫。
options_zh.B: 使用管理儲備來彌補任何延遲或損失，以繼續推進專案。
options_zh.C: 提議暫停此階段，以節省人力成本和資產折舊。
options_zh.D: 預先與其他供應商建立新的合作夥伴關係，以因應任何延誤。

question_text: An agile project is in its early iterations, but the project manager already realizes that more resources will be needed to achieve the expected time lines. There are no internal resources. available. IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 155 What vendor strategy should the project manager use to maximize project delivery?

options.A: Use compression techniques to break down the scope and assign the scope pieces to different vendors with a fixed-price contract.
options.B: Use the contingency budget for hiring additional vendor resources to mitigate any project risk.
options.C: Engage in a time and materials (T&M) contract and hire a local vendor to support development.
options.D: Establish a solid view of the scope and requirements and engage a vendor with a fixed price contract.

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 / 2.4 / 2.6 整合計畫、資源與財務
concept_tag: 專案預算與資金限制 (Project Budget)
question_text_zh: 一個敏捷專案正處於早期迭代階段，但專案經理已經意識到需要更多資源才能達到預期時程。目前沒有可用的內部資源。專案經理應採用何種供應商策略來最大化專案交付？

options_zh.A: 使用壓縮技術分解範疇，並透過總價合約將各部分範疇分配給不同的供應商。
options_zh.B: 使用應變預算聘僱額外的供應商資源，以減輕任何專案風險。
options_zh.C: 採用工料合約（T&M）並聘僱當地供應商以支援開發。
options_zh.D: 建立對範疇與需求的穩固視野，並以總價合約聘請供應商。

question_text: A project manager submits several requests to purchase required hardware and knows from previous experience that this kind of procurement usually results in disputes between the company and its suppliers. How can the project manager mitigate this risk in the request for proposal (RFP) with suppliers?

options.A: Ask the legal team to review the RFP.
options.B: Ask the project team to submit the RFP.
options.C: Request approval of the RFP from the project sponsor.
options.D: Request approval of the RFP from management.

options_list.text: Ask the legal team to review the RFP.
Ask the project team to submit the RFP.

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)

question_text_zh: 專案經理提交了數項採購所需硬體的請求，並從先前的經驗中得知，此類採購通常會導致公司與其供應商之間產生爭議。專案經理如何在向供應商提出的徵求建議書（RFP）中減輕此風險？

options_zh.A: 請法務團隊審查 RFP。
options_zh.B: 請專案團隊提交 RFP。
options_zh.C: 請求專案贊助者核准 RFP。
options_zh.D: 請求管理階層核准 RFP。

question_text: A project manager is working on a project to modernize the information technology of a bank, The project manager is facing challenges with the project sponsor regarding how to proceed with implementation of a key piece of technology. How should the project manager resolve this conflict?

options.A: Meet with all project stakeholders to identify how to implement the technology.
options.B: Identify the disagreement in the risk register and develop a contingency plan.
options.C: Update the project charter to align with the desires of the project sponsor.
options.D: Negotiate with the project sponsor to develop a mutually beneficial solution.

options_list.text: Meet with all project stakeholders to identify how to implement the technology.

question_text_zh: 專案經理正在執行一個將銀行資訊科技現代化的專案。專案經理與專案贊助者在如何推進一項關鍵技術的實施方面面臨挑戰。專案經理應如何解決此衝突？

options_zh.A: 與所有專案利害關係人開會，以確定如何實施該技術。
options_zh.B: 在風險登錄表中記錄此分歧並制定應變計畫。
options_zh.C: 更新專案章程以配合專案贊助者的意願。
options_zh.D: 與專案贊助者協商，以制定互利的解決方案。

options.A: Assess the risk of the contractor not attending meetings and submitting reports for the rest of the project and escalate it to the project sponsor.

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.5 / 2.7 / 2.8 採購、品質與時程
concept_tag: 合約類型與管理 (Contracts: FFP/CPFF/T&M)
question_text_zh: 一項新的主要道路專案即將展開，承包商已在合約中承諾定期提交狀況報告並參加整合會議。在專案生命週期進行到一半時，承包商停止參加會議並停止提交報告，聲稱這些事項耗費太多時間。專案經理首先應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 評估承包商在專案剩餘期間不出席會議和不提交報告的風險，並將其向上提報給專案贊助者。
options_zh.B: 針對未履行合約條款提出索賠，並依據替代爭議解決程序處理索賠。
options_zh.C: 提醒承包商，他們已依合約承諾參加會議並提交報告。
options_zh.D: 與公司法務人員溝通，並要求其敦促承包商履行合約承諾。

question_text_zh: 一項新法規已獲批准，該法規將影響專案第四階段的交付標的。該交付標的正採用反覆式方法進行，目前正在完成第二階段。專案經理下一步應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 諮詢專案贊助者以討論成本增加問題。
options_zh.B: 取得實施新法規的例外核准。
options_zh.C: 從指導委員會獲得額外預算的核准。
options_zh.D: 與主題專家（SME）開會，以評估對專案目標的影響。

options.A: Phone conversations
options.B: Video conferencing
options.C: Encrypted emails
options.D: Chat conversations

options_zh.A: 電話對話
options_zh.B: 視訊會議
options_zh.C: 加密電子郵件
options_zh.D: 即時通訊聊天

One of the team's integration leads is a subject matter expert (SME) m this integration area. The other team's integration lead is not a SME but is more senior and has worked on the project longer Both team leads are blaming each other What should the project manager do first to resolve this situation?

options.A: Assign the resolution of the issue to the senior integration lead who has worked on the project longer
options.B: Meet with both integration leads to understand the root cause and determine a resolution
options.C: Escalate the issue to the program architect who developed the integration plan
options.D: Assign the resolution of this issue to the integration lead who is a SME

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)

question_text_zh: 專案經理正在管理一個計畫中的兩個整合專案。一個關鍵的整合點未對齊，導致了延誤。其中一個團隊的整合負責人是該整合領域的主題專家（SME）。另一個團隊的整合負責人不是 SME，但資歷較深且在專案中工作的時間更長。兩位團隊負責人互相指責。專案經理首先應該做什麼來解決這種情況？

options_zh.A: 指派在專案中工作時間較長的資深整合負責人來解決問題。
options_zh.B: 與兩位整合負責人開會，以了解根本原因並確定解決方案。
options_zh.C: 將問題向上提報給制定整合計畫的計畫架構師。
options_zh.D: 指派身為 SME 的整合負責人來解決此問題。

question_text: A company strictly uses an agile approach, and the backlogs are continuously updated. A new project lead is hired and feels uncomfortable sharing some of the product's vital information with the team and the product owner. What does the project lead need to do to prevent a risky situation in the next iterations? IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 157

options.A: Keep the project focused and executed in silos for better outcomes.
options.B: Report the concern to the agile project management office (PMO),
options.C: Inform the product owner of the concern so that i can be addressed.
options.D: Open up to the team to work collaboratively to achieve the outcomes.

Report the concern to the agile project management office (PMO),

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)
eco_task_tag: ECO 3.3 / 3.4 / 3.5 風險、變更與障礙議題
concept_tag: 專案風險管理 (Project Risk Management)
question_text_zh: 一家公司嚴格採用敏捷方法，待辦清單會持續更新。新進聘用的一位專案領導人對於與團隊和產品負責人分享產品的某些重要資訊感到不自在。專案領導人需要做什麼來預防下一次反覆迭代中出現風險狀況？

options_zh.A: 讓專案保持聚焦並在各自獨立的穀倉中執行，以獲得更好的成果。
options_zh.B: 將此疑慮回報給敏捷專案管理辦公室（PMO）。
options_zh.C: 將此疑慮告知產品負責人以便進行處理。
options_zh.D: 向團隊敞開心胸，透過協同合作以達成成果。

question_text: During the execution phase of a project, a project manager notices that the project team is not motivated and performance is decreasing. The decision is made to invest in financial rewards for all of the Key team members. After the rewards are distributed, the team is still underperforming. What should the project manager have done to avoid this situation?

options.A: Determined the appropriate type of incentive for key team members
options.B: Conducted frequent monitoring on key team members' performance during project execution
options.C: Distributed the monetary incentive according to the team members' individual performance
options.D: identified the underperforming team members and asked the human resources (HR) department to replace them

options_list.text: Determined the appropriate type of incentive for key team members
Conducted frequent monitoring on key team members' performance during project execution
Distributed the monetary incentive according to the team members' individual performance
identified the underperforming team members and asked the human resources (HR) department to replace them

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)

concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 在專案執行階段，專案經理注意到專案團隊缺乏動力且績效正在下降。於是決定對所有關鍵團隊成員投入金錢獎勵。在發放獎勵後，團隊的績效仍然不佳。專案經理當初應該做什麼來避免這種情況？

options_zh.A: 確定適合關鍵團隊成員的激勵類型。
options_zh.B: 在專案執行期間對關鍵團隊成員的績效進行頻繁的監控。
options_zh.C: 根據團隊成員的個人績效發放金錢激勵。
options_zh.D: 識別出績效不佳的團隊成員，並要求人力資源（HR）部門更換他們。

question_text: A project manager is in the middle of an agile project comprised of 100 user stories broken down into five iterations Each user story is worth USS50 The actual expenditure is US$2,000 and 50 user stories have been delivered. Which statement is true''

options.A: The project is on budget and on schedule.
options.B: The project is over budget and behind schedule
options.C: The project is under budget and behind schedule.
options.D: The project is under budget and on schedule.

options_list.text: The project is on budget and on schedule.
The project is over budget and behind schedule
The project is under budget and behind schedule.
The project is under budget and on schedule.

options_zh.C: 專案低於預算且進度落後。
options_zh.D: 專案低於預算且進度正常。

options.A: Discuss the budget with the team during the daily standups to ensure the budget is under control.
options.B: Review budget-related lessons learned from similar projects.

options.D: Implement an agile approach to avoid using a fixed budget,

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)

options_zh.A: 在每日站立會議中與團隊討論預算，以確保預算受到控制。
options_zh.B: 審查類似專案中與預算相關的經驗學習。
options_zh.C: 邀請客戶參加專案啟動會議，並在會議中制定專案預算。
options_zh.D: 實施敏捷方法以避免使用固定預算。

options.A: Select resources who are more experienced with the new technology
options.B: Perform a root-cause analysis to measure how the new training will address the issue
options.C: Include in the risk register a risk of unskilled resources for the new technology
options.D: Elaborate and socialize the team charter as per the resource management plan

Perform a root-cause analysis to measure how the new training will address the issue

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)

question_text_zh: 專案經理為所有團隊成員規劃了針對一項新技術的詳細且昂貴的培訓計畫。該培訓在專案執行階段幾個月後展開。令人驚訝的是，仍然出現了許多與團隊成員能力不足相關的問題，且培訓成本現在正在對預算基準產生負面影響。專案經理下一步應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 選擇對該新技術更有經驗的資源。
options_zh.B: 進行根本原因分析，以評估新培訓如何解決該問題。
options_zh.C: 在風險登錄表中納入新技術缺乏熟練資源的風險。
options_zh.D: 根據資源管理計畫詳細制定並宣傳團隊章程。

question_text: An innovation project with a budget of over US$30 million is expected to have a large impact on the technology industry. What should the project manager do to manage business concerns and expectations before starting the project?

options.A: Meet with the project finance team to measure market variations and product impact. (B). Direct the project team to estimate user stories in greater detail.
options.C: Ask the product owner to prioritize the backlog items based on the return on investment (ROI).
options.D: Request that the project team develop a release plan and roadmap for the project.

options_zh.A: 與專案財務團隊開會，以衡量市場變化和產品影響。
options_zh.B: 指示專案團隊更詳細地估算使用者故事。
options_zh.C: 要求產品負責人根據投資報酬率（ROI）排定待辦清單項目的優先順序。
options_zh.D: 要求專案團隊制定專案的發行計畫和藍圖。

question_text: A team is ready to start working on a project with a customer who was very difficult to work with in the past because the customer was unable to describe exactly what they wanted What approach should the project manager take to remove this impediment?

options.A: Follow a predictive approach in order to obtain formal acceptance of each deliverable
options.B: Work with the product owner to define the minimum viable product(s)
options.C: Reinforce the negotiation and soft skills of the team through training

question_text_zh: 一個團隊已準備好開始與一位過去非常難以合作的客戶進行專案，因為該客戶過去無法確切描述他們想要什麼。專案經理應該採取什麼方法來消除這個阻礙？

options_zh.A: 遵循預測型方法，以獲得每項交付標的的正式驗收。
options_zh.B: 與產品負責人合作定義最小可行產品（MVP）。
options_zh.C: 透過培訓強化團隊的談判與軟實力技能。
options_zh.D: 制定並監控帶有到期日的計畫，以縮短完成產品的時間。

options.A: Work on resolving the differences with the key resource and building a good working relationship to ensure project success.
options.B: Monitor the key resource closely throughout the project, but do not let the project sponsor know about the conflict.

chapter_tag: 07. 領導及賦能團隊 (衝突管理、僕人式領導、團隊發展階段、情商)

options_zh.A: 致力於解決與該關鍵資源的分歧，建立良好的工作關係以確保專案成功。
options_zh.B: 在整個專案期間密切監控該關鍵資源，但不要讓專案贊助者知道衝突情況。
options_zh.C: 要求該關鍵資源的職能經理在專案期間直接與該資源協同工作。
options_zh.D: 與專案贊助者討論此事，並要求在專案中更換該關鍵資源。

question_text: A project manager is working on the budget for a long-term project. The project manager creates a work breakdown structure (WBS) and estimates the cost for each work package based on past projects. What else does the project manager need to do before determining the budget baseline? (A). Look at a previous project to ensure the budget totals match.

options.B: Require all stakeholders to review and approve the estimates.
options.C: Revise the project timeline and scope based on the WBS.
options.D: Add contingency into the budget for inflation and other changes.

options_zh.A: 檢視先前的專案以確保預算總額相符。
options_zh.B: 要求所有利害關係人審查並核准這些估算。
options_zh.C: 根據 WBS 修改專案時程和範疇。
options_zh.D: 在預算中增加應變準備金以因應通貨膨脹及其他變更。

question_text: A project manager is managing a large project. A stakeholder has just discovered a new risk that has not been identified in earlier stages. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Communicate the risk to the steering committee and request a mitigation plan from senior management.
options.B: Perform a risk analysis directly with the stakeholder who raised the risk and update the risk register.
options.C: Confirm to the stakeholder that the risk register has been completed and validated by all stakeholders.
options.D: Add the risk to the risk register and reevaluate the register with help from the project team and stakeholders.

question_text_zh: 一名已完成 50% 專案進度的 IT 專案經理得知，一名關鍵團隊成員計畫近期遷居至另一個國家。專案剩餘部分仍需要該團隊成員。專案經理應該如何改善團隊動力？

options_zh.A: 要求所有團隊成員親自出席每週專案審查會議。
options_zh.B: 向該團隊成員提供激勵措施，使其留任至專案結束。
options_zh.C: 用具備相似資格且地理位置較近的人員替換該團隊成員。
options_zh.D: 安排每週視訊會議以監控該團隊成員的工作進度。

options.A: Accept the change and use contingency funds to implement this change with minimal schedule impacts
options.B: Reject the change because it is contrary to what was agreed to during earlier phases of the project
options.C: Transfer the change to the steering committee for them to evaluate and decide the appropriate next steps
options.D: Evaluate the proposed change with integrated change controls and discuss the change with the project sponsor

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)
eco_task_tag: ECO 3.3 / 3.4 / 3.5 風險、變更與障礙議題
concept_tag: 整合變更管制與 CCB (Change Control & CCB)
question_text_zh: 一位新的相關專案利害關係人在執行途中提出了對部分專案參數的變更建議。專案經理接下來應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 接受變更並使用應變準備金實施此變更，以將時程影響降至最低。
options_zh.B: 拒絕變更，因為它與專案早期階段所達成的協議相左。
options_zh.C: 將變更移交給指導委員會，由其進行評估並決定適當的後續步驟。
options_zh.D: 透過整體變更管制評估擬議的變更，並與專案贊助者討論該變更。

options.A: Have the team members resolve the issue on their own.
options.B: Highlight the impact of their behavior and motivate the team member to make improvements.
options.C: Gather information and find the root cause of the problem.
options.D: Document the escalated issue and address it at the end of the project.

options_list.text: Have the team members resolve the issue on their own.
Highlight the impact of their behavior and motivate the team member to make improvements.
Gather information and find the root cause of the problem.

question_text_zh: 一名資淺團隊成員向專案經理呈報一個問題，指稱另一名成員的人際關係技能導致團隊效率降低。專案經理首先應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 讓團隊成員自行解決問題。
options_zh.B: 指出其行為的影響，並激勵該團隊成員進行改善。
options_zh.C: 蒐集資訊並找出問題的根本原因。
options_zh.D: 記錄呈報的問題並在專案結束時處理。

question_text: A project team began working on a complex project that involves new technology as a product. The team is new to the technology and the proposed approach. Additionally, the customer is apprehensive about how the product will be received in the market. What should the project manager do to help the team and the customer?

options.A: Manage the risks associated with the proposed approach.
options.B: Assist the team with identifying the minimum viable product (MVP) to validate assumptions.
options.C: Coordinate with the business unit to get detailed requirements.
options.D: Work closely with the marketing team on market research and product segments

options_list.text: Manage the risks associated with the proposed approach.
Assist the team with identifying the minimum viable product (MVP) to validate assumptions.
Coordinate with the business unit to get detailed requirements.
Work closely with the marketing team on market research and product segments

chapter_tag: 03. 定義範疇、價值和成功準則 (WBS、待辦清單、允收準則、MVP)

question_text_zh: 專案團隊開始進行一項複雜專案，該專案涉及以新技術作為產品。團隊對該技術和擬議的方法尚不熟悉。此外，客戶對產品在市場上的接受度感到憂心。專案經理應該怎麼做來協助團隊和客戶？

options_zh.A: 管理與擬議方法相關的風險。
options_zh.B: 協助團隊識別最小可行產品（MVP）以驗證假設。
options_zh.C: 與業務部門協調以取得詳細需求。
options_zh.D: 與行銷團隊密切合作進行市場研究和產品細分。

What is the first thing the project manager should do"?

options.A: Include the requirement into the project and schedule it as soon as possible
options.B: Inform the project sponsor about the situation and request assistance
options.C: Evaluate the impact that the inclusion of this new requirement will have on project performance
options.D: Inform the stakeholder that it is impossible to add new requirements to an approved project scope

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)

question_text_zh: 專案經理正在管理一個即將結束執行階段的專案。一位高階利害關係人告知專案經理，一項非常重要的需求未包含在專案範疇中，且若沒有該需求，專案將無法提供任何價值。專案經理首先應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 將該需求納入專案中，並盡快排定其進度日程。
options_zh.B: 向專案贊助者通報情況並請求協助。
options_zh.C: 評估納入這項新需求對專案績效造成的影響。
options_zh.D: 通知利害關係人，已核准的專案範疇無法新增新需求。

question_text: An established project team with a good track record has been working on a project for one year The project manager trusts the team and the work they produce. Which term describes the project manager's management approach?

options.A: Laissez-faire
options.B: Transactional
options.C: Transformational
options.D: Charismatic

Transactional
Transformational

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)

question_text_zh: 一個績效良好的既有專案團隊已在專案上工作了一年。專案經理信任該團隊及其產出的工作。下列哪一個術語最能描述專案經理的管理作法？

options_zh.A: 放任型（Laissez-faire）
options_zh.B: 交易型（Transactional）
options_zh.C: 轉型/變革型（Transformational）
options_zh.D: 魅力型（Charismatic）

question_text: A few developers have submitted their resignation after completing their annual review and receiving their annual bonus. The project manager cannot find replacements for all of the developers in time to meet the project's deadline. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Request additional budget to recruit more developers.
options.B: Lower the recruitment criteria.
options.C: Log the issue in the issue log.
options.D: Analyze the impact and inform the stakeholders.

options_list.text: Request additional budget to recruit more developers.
Lower the recruitment criteria.
Log the issue in the issue log.
Analyze the impact and inform the stakeholders.

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)

concept_tag: 專案預算與資金限制 (Project Budget)
question_text_zh: 幾位開發人員在完成年度績效考核並領取年度獎金後提出了辭呈。專案經理無法及時找到所有開發人員的替代人選以符合專案的截止期限。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 要求額外預算以招募更多開發人員。
options_zh.B: 降低招募標準。
options_zh.C: 將此議題記錄在議題記錄簿中。
options_zh.D: 分析影響並通知利害關係人。

options.A: Book one-on-one meetings with the team members who are not speaking up during the daily meetings to get their updates
options.B: Check the ground rules of the meeting to review the initial agreement with the team members
options.C: Identify one team representative to speak up during the daily meeting and share the team updates IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 174
options.D: Use round-robin check-ins to facilitate the meeting so all participants have the opportunity to speak

chapter_tag: 07. 領導及賦能團隊 (衝突管理、僕人式領導、團隊發展階段、情商)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.2 / 1.3 管理衝突與領導團隊
concept_tag: 團隊章程與基本規則 (Team Charter / Ground Rules)
question_text_zh: 在專案執行期間，一個全球專案團隊使用視訊會議工具進行每日會議。然而，在這些會議中只有少數團隊成員積極參與，導致產生許多誤解。專案經理應該怎麼做來解決這個問題？

options_zh.A: 與在每日會議中未發言的團隊成員預約一對一會議，以獲取他們的最新進度
options_zh.B: 檢查會議的基本規則，以審查最初與團隊成員達成的協議
options_zh.C: 指定一位團隊代表在每日會議中發言並分享團隊最新進度
options_zh.D: 採用輪流發言（round-robin）的方式引導會議，讓所有參與者都有發言機會

question_text: A project manager has experience working with a specific provider that has been requested for an upcoming project. This provider often fails to meet deliverable dates; however, it is the only company with the specific experience required for the project. What should the project manager do during the planning phase?

options.A: Hire resources to obtain knowledge about the provider's specific capabilities.
options.B: Add penalty clauses to the contract and update the risk register.
options.C: Encourage the provider to work overtime with no additional costs to the project.
options.D: Contract another provider with less experience and give them a chance to provide the deliverables.

options_list.text: Hire resources to obtain knowledge about the provider's specific capabilities.
Add penalty clauses to the contract and update the risk register.
Encourage the provider to work overtime with no additional costs to the project.
Contract another provider with less experience and give them a chance to provide the deliverables.

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.5 / 2.7 / 2.8 採購、品質與時程
concept_tag: 合約類型與管理 (Contracts: FFP/CPFF/T&M)
question_text_zh: 專案經理擁有與某特定供應商合作的經驗，而該供應商被指定參與即將開展的專案。該供應商經常無法如期交付交付標的；然而，它是唯一擁有該專案所需特定經驗的公司。專案經理在規劃階段應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 聘請資源以獲取有關該供應商特定能力的知識。
options_zh.B: 在合約中增加罰則條款並更新風險登錄表。
options_zh.C: 鼓勵供應商加班，且不增加專案的額外成本。
options_zh.D: 與另一家經驗較少的供應商簽約，給他們提供交付標的的機會。

question_text: A project team is implementing a new solution that will be distributed worldwide. Due to a new issue that has a global impact, several government agencies are implementing new regulations that will affect the solution. The project manager must assess and prioritize the impact of these changes on the project scope/backlog. Which analytical tool can be used by the project manager to define this scenario?

options.A: Political, economic social, technological legal, and environmental (PESTLE)
options.B: Strengths, weaknesses opportunities, and threats (SWOT)
options.C: Valuable rare, inimitable resources, and organization (VRIO)
options.D: Net present value (NPV)

options_zh.A: 政治、經濟、社會、技術、法律與環境分析（PESTLE）
options_zh.B: 優勢、劣勢、機會與威脅分析（SWOT）
options_zh.C: 價值性、稀少性、難以模仿性與組織架構分析（VRIO）
options_zh.D: 淨現值（NPV）

options_zh.A: 規劃一場專注於該倡議之範疇、願景與使命的工作會議

options_zh.C: 進行標竿對照以確定該倡議的商業可行性
options_zh.D: 對新倡議進行影響分析，以確定專案應如何推展

options.D: Submit a change request to approve the offer

options_zh.A: 審查專案範疇並與承包商協商
options_zh.B: 拒絕該報價，因為其已包含在初始專案範疇內

question_text_zh: 專案團隊在理解有關需求的技術細節方面遇到困難。客戶最初並未提供該資訊，但該資訊在當前迭代中對於釐清任務應如何完成至關重要。專案經理應如何處理這種情況？

options_zh.A: 要求客戶審查並釐清當前短衝的功能定義
options_zh.B: 向客戶發送當前短衝的燃盡圖並尋求釐清。
options_zh.C: 培訓客戶並讓他們參與每日站立會議。
options_zh.D: 安排每週會議並與客戶進行產品審查以釐清需求

question_text: Due to unforeseen circumstances, a contractor was unable to mobilize the project team, which was necessary to conduct face-to-face meetings and discussions. Virtual meetings were subsequently put in place, but the local project team and end users now face a communication gap that is causing the team's low performance. What should the project manager do?

question_text_zh: 一位新團隊成員被指派至一個每個反覆運算都能穩定交付的團隊中。該新成員對許多遵循的流程並不了解，並開始對時程產生負面影響。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 將該新團隊成員列入績效改善計畫。
options_zh.B: 請另一位團隊成員分擔該新團隊成員的部分工作。
options_zh.C: 分配較簡單的工作活動給該新團隊成員。
options_zh.D: 在反覆運算中分配時間來指導 (Mentor) 該新團隊成員。

question_text: A project manager assigned team members to work in pairs on a large amount of technical reports. options.B: Improper assignment of tasks to team member pairings

options_zh.B: 團隊成員結對分工指派不當

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)

options_zh.A: 在產品完全發布之前，無法實現早期價值。
options_zh.B: 透過在初期階段測試最重要的功能以修正偏差，即可獲得早期價值。
options_zh.C: 只有在能向市場發布測試版（beta）產品時，才能獲得早期價值。
options_zh.D: 只有在提高將產品推向市場的速度時，才能獲得早期價值。

question_text: A risk was identified at the beginning of a project, and a response plan was established. Unforeseen consequences resulted in a higher level of risk. The project manager has an idea that could address the new risk in an efficient way, but the response is different from the original risk mitigation plan. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Submit the new response plan to the stakeholders for their review.
options.B: Obtain management approval prior to implementing the new risk response.
options.C: Use the management reserve to mitigate the risk.
options.D: Implement the new response to address the risk.

options_zh.A: 將新的因應計畫提交給利害關係人審查。
options_zh.B: 在實施新的風險因應措施之前取得管理階層的核准。
options_zh.C: 動用管理儲備來減輕風險。
options_zh.D: 實施新的因應措施以處理該風險。

question_text_zh: 專案經理正在執行一項大型營建專案。由於多數團隊成員採虛擬遠端工作，先前協議計畫的一部分是使用具備高速網際網路連線伺服器的雲端系統。公司需要盡可能降低營運成本，管理高層堅持該專案現在必須改用運行在傳統撥接服務上的系統。專案經理下一步應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 評估此決策的衝擊，並與管理高層進行溝通。
options_zh.B: 同意管理高層的意見，並繼續按照專案管理計畫執行。
options_zh.C: 就管理高層的決策與其會面，並請他們另尋專案經理。
options_zh.D: 更換部分遠端工作的團隊成員，以協助公司節省資金。

question_text: A construction project for a nuclear power plant will reduce the region's energy dependence on external electricity supplies. Which stakeholders should the project manager include in the stakeholder engagement plan ?

options.A: Stakeholders who have been identified and who have needs and a potential impact on the project.
options.B: Stakeholders who are selected by the project sponsor who have a potential impact on the project.
options.C: Stakeholders who disagree with the project so as to proactively manage their expectations.
options.D: Stakeholders who are supporting the project in order to obtain additional resources.

options_list.text: Stakeholders who have been identified and who have needs and a potential impact on the project.

Stakeholders who are supporting the project in order to obtain additional resources.

options_zh.B: 由專案贊助者選出且對專案具有潛在影響的利害關係人。
options_zh.C: 反對該專案的利害關係人，以主動管理其期望。
options_zh.D: 支持專案的利害關係人，以獲取額外資源。

question_text: A solution designer in an agile team often passes the design information to team members without any documentation, This has resulted in misunderstandings within the team. What should the agile leader do?

options.C: Stop work until the design document is completed.
options.D: Ask the team to document the design.

options_zh.A: 將該解決方案設計師調到另一個團隊。
options_zh.B: 審查導致這種情況的流程。
options_zh.C: 暫停工作，直到設計文件完成。
options_zh.D: 要求團隊將設計記錄成文件。

options_zh.A: 安排與新贊助者開會，以解釋敏捷方法以及團隊應如何自我組織。

options_zh.D: 在下一次疊代檢討會議期間與專案團隊討論贊助者的要求，以獲得團隊決策。

options_zh.A: 將該任務重新指派給團隊的其他成員。
options_zh.B: 透過增派一名資源立即完成該任務來支援該團隊成員。
options_zh.C: 詢問該團隊成員是否存在阻礙，並協助排除阻礙因素。
options_zh.D: 隨時向專案贊助者通報延誤情況。

question_text: A project manager is hired by a global company. The project manager is an agile specialist and is tasked with supporting the project team to reduce rework and dissatisfaction. How should the project manager address these objectives?

options.A: Decrease the scope of the portfolio and send new solutions to the customer.
options.B: Deliver a schedule with the portfolio timeline and delivery to the customer.
options.C: Adopt an incremental cycle of delivering value to the customer.
options.D: Prepare deliveries with more details to satisfy the customer.

options_zh.A: 縮減專案組合的範疇，並向客戶發送新的解決方案。

options_zh.A: 對資料外洩事件進行根本原因分析。
options_zh.B: 確保所有團隊成員均完成培訓。

question_text_zh: 一位專案經理被指派負責一項組織轉型專案。該公司通常在年初制定個人績效計畫，並由職能經理在年終進行回饋評估。轉型專案的團隊成員擔心他們為該專案所做的工作與他們該年度個人績效計畫中的工作不一致。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 與職能經理會面，以協調團隊成員的預期回報頻率及成果回報機制。
options_zh.B: 在年終時向團隊成員的職能經理提供績效回饋。
options_zh.C: 向團隊成員保證此專案對公司具有高度優先級，他們將獲得相應的評估。
options_zh.D: 請求負責該專案團隊成員的績效計畫制定。

question_text_zh: 投資委員會是審批業務改善專案所需資金的授權機構。投資委員會已批准完成初步可行性研究的資金。該專案時程緊迫，專案經理需要臨時資金來繼續必須立即開始的初步可行性活動。專案經理應如何讓這些資金獲得批准？

options_zh.A: 等到下一次投資委員會會議再提交申請，並計入因無法開工導致的時程延誤。
options_zh.B: 繼續進行初步活動，並在下個月的會議上告知投資委員會。
options_zh.C: 將初步範疇從整個專案範疇中排除，並將其作為不需要投資委員會批准的新專案繼續執行。
options_zh.D: 將申請提交給專案總監以取得臨時批准，並將該批准列入下一次投資委員會會議中進行討論。

options_zh.D: 舉辦團隊建立活動

options_zh.A: 在規劃階段，屆時將執行範疇定義、活動持續時間估算及排序等過程
options_zh.B: 盡快提供，因為及早制定時程可以顯著避免專案延誤

options_zh.A: 告知該利害關係人必須將其知識水平提升至與其他利害關係人一致。
options_zh.B: 更新風險登錄表以記錄潛在影響，並通知指導委員會。
options_zh.C: 通知專案管理辦公室（PMO），團隊將在此專案中採用預測型方法。
options_zh.D: 撥出時間指導該利害關係人熟悉所選用的專案方法。

options_zh.A: 根據行銷與業務團隊的回饋，規劃增量且反覆式的交付。
options_zh.B: 審查並更新成功準則，以確保該通路不會被停用。
options_zh.C: 告知利害關係人，待停用的通路清單已獲得執行長 (CEO) 的核准。
options_zh.D: 將此反對意見作為個人恐嚇事件呈報給指導委員會和人力資源部門 (HR)。

question_text: A company wants to launch a new product for customers. The project for this new product is in the development phase. Due to an uncertain environment, the project manager has doubts about the feasibility of the project. What should the project manager do in this situation?

options.A: Validate assumptions using appropriate tools to assess the risks.
options.B: Refer to the lessons learned to determine the impact on the external environment.
options.C: Recommend postponing the project until the uncertainty is resolved,
options.D: Highlight the concern to the project sponsor in the next project review meeting,

options_list.text: Validate assumptions using appropriate tools to assess the risks.
Refer to the lessons learned to determine the impact on the external environment.
Recommend postponing the project until the uncertainty is resolved,
Highlight the concern to the project sponsor in the next project review meeting,

chapter_tag: 06. 溝通與知識傳遞 (溝通管理、資訊發布器、經驗學習)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.7 / 1.8 溝通與知識傳遞
concept_tag: 經驗學習登錄表 (Lessons Learned Register)
question_text_zh: 某公司希望為客戶推出一項新產品。該新產品的專案目前正處於開發階段。由於環境充滿不確定性，專案經理對該專案的可行性產生了疑慮。在這種情況下，專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 使用適當的工具驗證假設，以評估風險。
options_zh.B: 參考經驗學習以確定對外部環境的影響。
options_zh.C: 建議將專案延期，直到不確定性消除為止。
options_zh.D: 在下一次專案審查會議中向專案贊助者提出該疑慮。

question_text: A project to implement a new process is still in development. When implemented, the company will benefit by a reduction in utility costs. The project financial evaluation indicates a payback of 3 years. What should the project manager do to expedite the project delivery?

options.A: Increase resources on the technical design to enable a decision to proceed as this is a quick return project.
options.B: Increase the time spent on project development to improve the level of confidence to validate the financial evaluation.
options.C: Conduct a stakeholder survey with the plant operators to establish the probability of this project reducing the cost of utilities.
options.D: Stop any further project development and commence with the implementation as there is no need to seek further approval.

options_list.text: Increase resources on the technical design to enable a decision to proceed as this is a quick return project.
Increase the time spent on project development to improve the level of confidence to validate the financial evaluation.
Conduct a stakeholder survey with the plant operators to establish the probability of this project reducing the cost of utilities.
Stop any further project development and commence with the implementation as there is no need to seek further approval.

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 發展整合專案計畫與基礎
concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 一個實施新流程的專案仍在開發中。一旦實施，公司將因公用事業成本的降低而受益。專案財務評估顯示回收期為 3 年。專案經理應該怎麼做以加速專案交付？

options_zh.A: 增加技術設計的資源，以便做出繼續推進的決策，因為這是一個快速回報的專案。
options_zh.B: 增加在專案開發上花費的時間，以提高驗證財務評估的信心水準。
options_zh.C: 與廠區操作人員進行利害關係人調查，以確定該專案降低公用事業成本的機率。
options_zh.D: 停止進一步的專案開發並直接開始實施，因為無需尋求進一步的批准。

question_text: A project manager has been assigned to lead a software project to generate savings at an IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 287 important financial institution. Initially, the duration of the project was 13 months, but due to various issues during execution, the project was extended to 16 months. By month 11, the expected savings were exceeded but not all of the functionalities planned for that date were fulfilled. How should the project manager inform the stakeholders of the project's progress?

options.A: Report that the project has not fulfilled all the expected functionalities.
options.B: Complete the outstanding functionalities before informing the sponsor of the project progress.
options.C: Communicate the benefit expectations and the action plan for the pending functionalities.
options.D: Send an email with the monthly project progress to all relevant stakeholders.

options_list.text: Report that the project has not fulfilled all the expected functionalities.
Complete the outstanding functionalities before informing the sponsor of the project progress.
Communicate the benefit expectations and the action plan for the pending functionalities.
Send an email with the monthly project progress to all relevant stakeholders.

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 發展整合專案計畫與基礎
concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 一位專案經理被指派領導一個軟體專案，為一家重要的金融機構節省開支。最初該專案的時程為 13 個月，但由於執行過程中的各種問題，專案被延長至 16 個月。到了第 11 個月，預期的成本節省已超出目標，但並非所有原定於該日期前完成的功能都已實現。專案經理應如何向利害關係人報告專案進度？

options_zh.A: 報告專案尚未實現所有預期功能。
options_zh.B: 在向贊助者報告專案進度之前，先完成未完成的功能。
options_zh.C: 溝通效益預期以及待處理功能的行動計畫。
options_zh.D: 向所有相關利害關係人發送包含專案每月進度的電子郵件。

question_text: An agile team is working on a project that will be launched in six countries. Each country has specific requirements in addition to the base offering. The estimates indicate it will take six months to develop the base offering and an additional month to finalize each country's unique requirements. The expected revenue for the product is the same for each country. Which release strategy should the project manager recommend?

options.A: A risk-based strategy to maximize the perceived value of the product by launching it to the countries with the lowest technical complexity
options.B: An iterative-based strategy to maximize value by releasing the product to each country as it is finalized and ready for release in that country
options.C: A quality-based strategy to maximize post-market adoption by releasing the product to the countries with the lowest probability of reporting field issues
options.D: A financial-based strategy to reduce the roll-out effort and costs by planning a single, bundled release to all countries at the same time

options_list.text: A risk-based strategy to maximize the perceived value of the product by launching it to the countries with the lowest technical complexity
An iterative-based strategy to maximize value by releasing the product to each country as it is finalized and ready for release in that country
A quality-based strategy to maximize post-market adoption by releasing the product to the countries with the lowest probability of reporting field issues
A financial-based strategy to reduce the roll-out effort and costs by planning a single, bundled release to all countries at the same time

chapter_tag: 05. 採購、品質與時程安排 (合約類型、品質保證/管制、要徑法、迭代規劃)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.5 / 2.7 / 2.8 採購、品質與時程
concept_tag: 品質管理與品質成本 (QA / QC / CoQ)
question_text_zh: 一個敏捷團隊正在進行一個將在六個國家推出的專案。除了基礎功能產品外，每個國家都有其特定的需求。預估顯示開發基礎產品需要六個月，而完成每個國家的獨特需求各需要額外一個月。該產品在每個國家的預期收入皆相同。專案經理應推薦哪種發布策略？

options_zh.A: 基於風險的策略：透過優先在技術複雜度最低的國家推出，以最大化產品的感知價值。
options_zh.B: 基於迭代的策略：當產品在各個國家定案且準備好發布時即進行發布，以實現價值最大化。
options_zh.C: 基於品質的策略：透過將產品發布到報告現場問題機率最低的國家，以最大化上市後的採用率。
options_zh.D: 基於財務的策略：透過規劃一次性綑綁發布至所有國家，以減少推廣工作量與成本。

question_text: One team member is not as active as the rest of the team during a brainstorming session The project manager has a separate conversation with the team member and learns that the team member is slightly hearing impaired The team member appreciates the project manager's concern The project manager then decides to change the time and room for the meeting to ensure everyone can participate What interpersonal skill did the project manager use?

options.A: Networking
options.B: Emotional intelligence
options.C: Conflict management
options.D: Influencing

options_list.text: Networking
Emotional intelligence
Conflict management
Influencing

chapter_tag: 07. 領導及賦能團隊 (衝突管理、僕人式領導、團隊發展階段、情商)

concept_tag: 衝突管理策略 (Conflict Management)
question_text_zh: 在腦力激盪會議中，一位團隊成員不如其他團隊成員活躍。專案經理與該團隊成員進行了私下溝通，得知該團隊成員有輕微聽力障礙。該團隊成員對專案經理的關心表示感謝。專案經理隨後決定更換會議的時間與會議室，以確保每個人都能參與。專案經理使用了哪項人際關係技能？

options_zh.A: 建立人際網路 (Networking)
options_zh.B: 情緒智商 (Emotional intelligence)
options_zh.C: 衝突管理 (Conflict management)
options_zh.D: 發揮影響力 (Influencing)

question_text: The project velocity has recently slipped, and a decision was made to skip testing to increase the momentum and bong the project back on track What will the project manager need to focus on as a result of this decision? IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 288

options.A: Increased bum rate
options.B: Increased cost
options.C: Increased technical debt
options.D: Decreased efficiency

Increased cost
Increased technical debt

chapter_tag: 09. 監督進度並保持一致 (實獲值管理 EVM、燃盡圖、績效指標 KPI/OKR)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.6 / 2.9 評估專案狀態與監督績效

question_text_zh: 專案的開發速度（Velocity）最近下滑，團隊決定跳過測試以提升推進力並使專案重回正軌。這項決定會導致專案經理需要關注下列哪項問題？

options_zh.A: 燃盡率 (Burn rate) 增加
options_zh.B: 成本增加
options_zh.C: 技術債 (Technical debt) 增加
options_zh.D: 效率降低

question_text: A project manager is part of a global project team and is in charge of managing the scope defined by their country. There is a clear division regarding which pieces of the scope should be treated by global and local teams. During the last sprints, the project manager has been receiving requests that the global team should handle. What should the project manager do in this situation?

options.A: Reject the workload back to the global team.
options.B: Assess the team's capacity to absorb the workload.
options.C: Evaluate and understand the cause of the conflict.
options.D: Escalate the situation to the project sponsor.

options_list.text: Reject the workload back to the global team.
Assess the team's capacity to absorb the workload.
Evaluate and understand the cause of the conflict.
Escalate the situation to the project sponsor.

chapter_tag: 02. 建立基礎—願景、利害關係人與治理 (專案章程、利害關係人參與、治理結構)

concept_tag: 專案願景 (Project Vision)

options_zh.A: 將工作量退回給全球團隊。
options_zh.B: 評估團隊吸收該工作量的能量。
options_zh.C: 評估並理解衝突發生的原因。
options_zh.D: 將此情況呈報給專案贊助者。

options_zh.A: 專案稽核
options_zh.B: 經驗學習
options_zh.C: 組織過程資產
options_zh.D: 採購稽核

options_zh.A: 與專案贊助者討論此問題。
options_zh.B: 審查要徑上各項任務所需的資源。
options_zh.C: 審查並更新風險管理計畫。
options_zh.D: 分配資源以培養其他團隊成員的能力。

question_text_zh: 在專案進行過程中，一位初階團隊成員向專案經理請教關於風險減輕措施的指導與建議。專案經理應該如何回應？

options_zh.A: 告訴該初階團隊成員可以在經驗學習中找到該資訊。
options_zh.B: 提供指導，並為該初階團隊成員安排後續的能力發展活動。
options_zh.C: 告知該初階團隊成員風險減輕不是其工作範疇。
options_zh.D: 引導該初階團隊成員去請教制定風險減輕策略的資深團隊成員。

options.A: Ask the sponsor to identify requirements for a new project to monitor and report achievement of the benefits.
options.B: Direct the team to implement the benefits management plan and track achievements before the end of the project.
options.C: Coordinate with the stakeholders to ensure the benefits management plan is in alignment with the goals.
options.D: Update the work breakdown structure (WBS) and project schedule with tasks and resources to track benefits realization.

options_zh.A: 要求贊助者確定新專案的需求，以監控並報告效益的達成情況。
options_zh.B: 指示團隊在專案結束前實施效益管理計畫並追蹤成果。
options_zh.C: 與利害關係人進行協調，以確保效益管理計畫與目標保持一致。
options_zh.D: 在工作分解結構 (WBS) 與專案時程中更新任務與資源，以追蹤效益實現。

options_zh.B: 與團隊討論開始進行該項目所帶來的影響。
options_zh.C: 在分解該項目之前，先完成進行中的小型任務。
options_zh.D: 與專案贊助者溝通其影響。

question_text_zh: 專案團隊正與一家供應商共同建置企業通報工具。專案經理注意到該供應商的開發人員連續數週回報相同的進度狀態。數天後，供應商告知因其內部資源受限，交付標的將無法如期完成。專案經理接下來應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 更新風險登錄表以反映延遲，溝通對時程的影響，並向上呈報給管理階層以獲取協助。
options_zh.B: 與專案贊助者進行專案審查以解釋延遲原因，並增加一名開發人員與供應商共同工作。
options_zh.C: 審查與供應商的合約，以確認適用於此情況的違約罰款條款。
options_zh.D: 將延遲記錄至議題記錄中，並與供應商共同尋求能使時程回到正軌的解決方案。

options.A: Emphasize to the teams the importance of meeting the agreed deadlines
options.B: Provide appropriate training to compensate for the mismatch.
options.C: Update the project schedule to reflect the delay
options.D: Accept the risk of the project missing deadlines due to the mismatch.

options_list.text: Emphasize to the teams the importance of meeting the agreed deadlines

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)

options_zh.A: 向團隊強調達成約定期限的重要性
options_zh.B: 提供適當的培訓以彌補職能的不匹配。
options_zh.C: 更新專案時程以反映延遲
options_zh.D: 接受專案因職能不匹配而錯過期限的風險。

options_zh.B: 妥善結案採購流程

options_zh.B: 向專案管理辦公室（PMO）報告延遲情況以及糾正措施。

options_zh.A: 建立一份溝通管理計畫，概述與利害關係人溝通的方法。

options_zh.A: 確保該分析師在整個任務執行過程中與另一位團隊成員進行定期的結對會議

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)

options_zh.A: 在障礙看板（impediment board）中建立一個項目並指派它。
options_zh.B: 邀請專案團隊進行群聚工作（swarming）會議以定義解決方案
options_zh.C: 利用原部門的人際網絡並請求協助

question_text: A project manager has been assigned a project to build a new solar farm that will provide clean energy to a new housing complex. The government has decided to reduce the tax on renewable energy products starting 1 January. The supplier has reached out and stated that the order placed for solar panels to be delivered on 20 December might be delayed until early January. On the other hand, the project will face similar constraints due to the December holidays. What should the project manager do about this risk?

options.A: Update the risk register and take advantage of the opportunity.
options.B: Review the supplier's contract to understand the terms of sale.
options.C: Accept the risk and update the risk register.
options.D: Insist that the supplier deliver the goods on the agreed date.

options_list.text: Update the risk register and take advantage of the opportunity.
Review the supplier's contract to understand the terms of sale.
Accept the risk and update the risk register.
Insist that the supplier deliver the goods on the agreed date.

options_zh.A: 更新風險登錄表並把握這個機會。
options_zh.B: 審查供應商的合約以了解銷售條款。
options_zh.C: 接受該風險並更新風險登錄表。
options_zh.D: 堅持要求供應商在約定日期交貨。

options_zh.A: 將專家角色特定面向的控制權移交出去，讓他們自行議定時程與目標。

options_zh.C: 為所有團隊成員定義角色與目標，並定期透過一對一面談進行後續追蹤以審查進度。
options_zh.D: 與團隊成員合作定義整體目標，並支援他們圍繞著該目標全力投入。

options_zh.A: 請求管理階層由前任贊助者取代新任贊助者。
options_zh.B: 請求前任贊助者與專案團隊討論各項變更。
options_zh.C: 探索向新任贊助者分享專案願景與成果的方法。
options_zh.D: 尋找繞過新任贊助者並直接向管理階層尋求支援的方法。

options.A: Wait to start the project execution phase until all requirements and acceptance criteria are clear.
options.B: Ask the customer to include all of the requirements in the project charter to officially start the project planning phase.

options_zh.A: 等待所有需求與驗收準則明確後，再開始專案執行階段。
options_zh.B: 要求客戶將所有需求納入專案章程，以正式啟動專案規劃階段。
options_zh.C: 安排一場腦力激盪會議，並挑選出前十項最重要的需求。
options_zh.D: 在規劃會議中，聚焦於快速發布最小可行產品（MVP）並獲取終端使用者的回饋。

question_text: An agile project team discovers that they are unable to implement a feature completely in the first iteration The team believes it may not be able to complete the tasks in the second iteration. concept_tag: 合約類型與管理 (Contracts: FFP/CPFF/T&M)
question_text_zh: 某公司現有一份維護及強化客戶資料庫的合約。公司的法務部門通知專案經理，一項要求更嚴格保護客戶資訊的新法規可能很快就會簽署成為法律。該法律將要求在專案經理目前維護的資料庫中實施額外的安全功能。這些功能並未包含在現行合約的範疇內。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 請法務部門在下一次與客戶進行合約談判時提出此議題
options_zh.B: 尋求專案贊助者的支持，以影響客戶立即修改合約
options_zh.C: 更新風險登錄表以納入此議題，並與專案贊助者和客戶討論適當的風險應對計畫
options_zh.D: 等待法規要求最終確定，以便能具體定義範疇變更

options.A: Schedule team-building activities to encourage collaboration among the team
options.B: Coach the team members to resolve the gaps in understanding
options.C: Conduct a kick-off meeting and communicate the goals and objectives of the project
options.D: Continue the meetings and communicate the goals and objectives to resolve the gaps

options_list.text: Schedule team-building activities to encourage collaboration among the team

question_text_zh: 一位敏捷專案經理的專案團隊中擁有來自不同大洲的團隊成員。在每日每日站立會議（Scrum）期間，專案經理注意到成員對專案目標與標的之理解存在落差。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 安排團隊建立活動以鼓勵團隊之間的協作
options_zh.B: 輔導團隊成員以化解理解上的落差
options_zh.C: 召開專案啟動會議並溝通專案的目標與標的
options_zh.D: 繼續開會並傳達目標與標的以消除落差

question_text: An international client contacted a software development company to build out a software product, and an agile project manager was assigned. At one of the review meetings, the client complains that a feature mentioned at the initial debriefing was not implemented. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Include the mentioned feature in the prioritized requirements list.
options.B: Assign a team member to immediately start working on that feature.
options.C: Review the original project documentation to confirm.
options.D: Treat it as a change request and assess the effect on the project's goals.

options_list.text: Include the mentioned feature in the prioritized requirements list.
Assign a team member to immediately start working on that feature.
Review the original project documentation to confirm.
Treat it as a change request and assess the effect on the project's goals.

question_text_zh: 某國際客戶聯繫了一家軟體開發公司以建置一套軟體產品，並指派了一位敏捷專案經理。在其中一次檢視會議中，客戶抱怨最初簡報時提到的一項功能並未被實作。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 將所提到的功能納入已排列優先順序的需求清單中。
options_zh.B: 指派團隊成員立即開始進行該功能的工作。
options_zh.C: 檢視原始專案文件以進行確認。
options_zh.D: 將其視為變更請求，並評估對專案目標的影響。

question_text: An iteration is almost finished, but the team is struggling to complete the stories that require more time. What should the project manager do first?

options.A: Meet with the project team to develop a proper resolution to the issue.
options.B: Update the project artifacts to reflect the new deadlines reported.
options.C: Request approval from the project sponsor to add more resources,
options.D: Prepare documentation to explain the issue and communicate accordingly.

options_list.text: Meet with the project team to develop a proper resolution to the issue.
Update the project artifacts to reflect the new deadlines reported.

Prepare documentation to explain the issue and communicate accordingly.

options_zh.A: 與專案團隊開會，以制定該問題的適當解決方案。
options_zh.B: 更新專案產出物以反映回報的新截止日期。
options_zh.C: 請求專案贊助者核准增加更多資源。
options_zh.D: 準備文件以解釋該問題並進行相應的溝通。

What should the project manager do?

options.A: Prepare and submit a status report to the steering committee to update performance monitoring
options.B: Determine the data to be monitored during the project as well as the expected performance and targets. IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 315
options.C: Update the communications management plan to consider performance review meetings with the project stakeholders
options.D: Conduct reviews with stakeholders to discuss the potential benefits the approach may have to the project

options_zh.A: 準備狀況報告並提交給指導委員會，以更新績效監控
options_zh.B: 確定專案期間要監控的數據以及預期的績效與目標
options_zh.C: 更新溝通管理計畫，以納入與專案利害關係人的績效審查會議
options_zh.D: 與利害關係人進行檢視會議，討論該方法可能為專案帶來的潛在效益

question_text: After conducting a performance assessment, the project manager identified that some gaps still exist. What should the project manager ensure?

options.A: Assessment results are kept private and not shared among team members.
options.B: Performance improvement programs are organized for all team members who were assessed.
options.C: All team members rotate their job schedules immediately to make them versatile.
options.D: Awards are given to all team members for playing a role in the project and undertaking the assessment.

options_list.text: Assessment results are kept private and not shared among team members.

options_zh.A: 評估結果保持保密，不在團隊成員之間共享。
options_zh.B: 為所有接受評估的團隊成員組織績效提升計畫。
options_zh.C: 所有團隊成員立即輪調工作時程，以使他們具備多功能能力。
options_zh.D: 對所有團隊成員頒發獎勵，以表揚他們在專案中發揮的作用並參與評估。

options_zh.D: 請公司律師致函市政府，拒絕該變更，因為這不屬於市政府最初核准的範疇。

options_zh.B: 聘請仲裁人以解決處理新需求時產生的任何衝突

options_zh.C: 將此回饋記錄在會議紀錄中
options_zh.D: 開始規劃如何提前下一批交付標的的日期

options_zh.B: 分配時間指導團隊。

options.B: Choose the agile practices that can be implemented in this type of construction project and apply them. IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 333
options.C: Review the stages of the project to allocate additional budget for agile resources.

options_zh.A: 聘請顧問以獲得關於敏捷是否可應用於建築工程專案的第二意見。
options_zh.B: 選擇可在此類建築工程專案中實施的敏捷實務做法並加以應用。
options_zh.C: 檢視專案的各個階段，以便為敏捷資源分配額外預算。
options_zh.D: 為專案指派一名敏捷教練（Scrum Master），以在專案中推行敏捷實務做法。

question_text: A state-of-the-art product was delivered at the end of a project life cycle. However, the customer claims the product was not designed to specifications. What should the project manager have done to avoid this issue?

options.A: The customer's requirements should have been captured in order to meet the customer's standards.
options.B: The iteration review planning meeting should have been planned accordingly.
options.C: The sprint retrospective meeting should have included necessary stakeholders.
options.D: The customer's requirements should have been captured and modified to meet the supplier's standards.

question_text_zh: 在專案生命週期結束時交付了一款最先進的產品。然而，客戶聲稱該產品並未依照規格進行設計。專案經理本應採取什麼行動來避免此問題？

options_zh.A: 本應蒐集客戶的需求，以符合客戶的標準。
options_zh.B: 本應相應地規劃迭代審查規劃會議。
options_zh.C: 短衝回顧會議本應納入必要的利害關係人。
options_zh.D: 本應蒐集並修改客戶的需求，以符合供應商的標準。

question_text: At a meeting to receive approval for the project management plan, a project manager realizes that there is so much detail in the presentation that many of the stakeholders are not actively engaged in the process. The stakeholders are agreeing to the scope, goals, and timelines without giving them substantial thought. How should the project manager proceed?

options.A: Stop the meeting and reschedule for another time with a more concise presentation.
options.B: Set up information review sessions before reconvening another approval session.
options.C: Get approval and promise to email more information to the stakeholders to clarify the technical details.
options.D: Obtain approval as fast as possible and close the meeting.

options_list.text: Stop the meeting and reschedule for another time with a more concise presentation.

options_zh.A: 暫停會議，並使用更簡潔的簡報重新排定其他時間進行。
options_zh.B: 在重新召開另一次核准會議之前，先安排資訊審查會議。
options_zh.C: 獲得核准，並承諾透過電子郵件向利害關係人發送更多資訊以釐清技術細節。
options_zh.D: 盡快獲得核准並結束會議。

options_zh.A: 所有利害關係人都很重要，因此專案經理應遵照管理層與關鍵利害關係人所提供的指示

options_zh.D: 這是一個敏捷專案，因此僅聽從專案經理的主管以及組織職能經理的指示

options_zh.A: 親自接觸該利害關係人以解決其關切事項。
options_zh.B: 查閱風險管理計畫。

options_zh.D: 將該利害關係人轉介給專案贊助者。

options.A: Send out a status report describing the situation to the stakeholders and request general assistance.

options_zh.A: 向利害關係人發送描述此情況的現況報告，並請求通盤協助。

options_zh.D: 要求高階管理層更多地參與專案並提供他們的全力支援。

options_zh.D: 為團隊成員提供溝通技巧和人際行為方面的培訓

options_zh.C: 確保工作頻繁且持續整合，以獲得早期回饋和持續學習。
options_zh.D: 為團隊安排關於整合概念的線上會議並建議工具。

options_zh.A: 提交變更請求以使專案目標適應當前情況
options_zh.B: 要求 Scrum 敏捷教練精煉使用者故事，以增進團隊成員的理解

options_zh.B: 維持現有的關鍵工作人員，因為專案已經開始。

options_zh.A: 準時交付給接收端經理，該經理隨後可對其團隊進行知識轉移。

options_zh.D: 發出內部變更請求以確保額外兩週的資源。

options_zh.B: 在專案進度更新期間將延誤情況通知利害關係人。

options_zh.D: 透過制定替代計畫使解決方案在未完全整合的情況下立即可用，藉此減輕風險。

options_zh.D: 評估每位團隊成員親自或線上參加每日會議的能力，並縮短每次會議的時間。

options_zh.B: 與風險經理會面，以識別與時程延誤相關的潛在威脅。
options_zh.C: 安排與專案贊助者會面，並針對產品範疇提交變更請求。
options_zh.D: 啟動針對範疇與品質的專案計畫，並尋找交付方案以滿足利害關係人的期望。

question_text: Halfway through a project, the project sponsor is replaced by another peer who was not previously engaged in the project. The new project sponsor has rejected most of the project artifacts, and the team did not get the latest increment approved on the current iteration. Stakeholders are not feeling confident about the project outcome. What should the project manager have done to prevent this situation?

options.A: Performed a stakeholder analysis when the sponsor joined the project
options.B: Held a governance meeting to review the project increment
options.C: Conducted a product iteration review with the new project sponsor IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 362
options.D: Escalated the issue to ensure the increment would be approved

Held a governance meeting to review the project increment

chapter_tag: 02. 建立基礎—願景、利害關係人與治理 (專案章程、利害關係人參與、治理結構)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.1 / 1.4 / 3.1 願景、利害關係人與治理
concept_tag: 專案治理 (Project Governance)
question_text_zh: 在專案進行到一半時，專案贊助者被另一位先前未參與專案的同儕取代。新任專案贊助者退回了大部分的專案產出物，且團隊在當前反覆迭代中的最新增量未獲得核准。利害關係人對專案結果感到缺乏信心。專案經理當初應該做什麼來預防這種情況？

options_zh.A: 在贊助者加入專案時進行利害關係人分析
options_zh.B: 召開治理會議以審查專案增量
options_zh.C: 與新任專案贊助者進行產品迭代審查
options_zh.D: 將問題上報以確保增量能獲得核准

question_text: In the beginning of project execution, the project manager finds out that a key resource will be unavailable for two weeks which could cause a delay to the schedule What should the project manager do first?

options.A: Assign the tasks to another resource, and ask the resource to work double shifts
options.B: Update the schedule to reflect the project's changes in duration
options.C: Ask human resources (HR) for a replacement, and update the nsk register
options.D: Update the resource management plan and resource allocation chart accordingly

options_list.text: Assign the tasks to another resource, and ask the resource to work double shifts

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)

concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 在專案執行初期，專案經理發現某個關鍵資源將有兩週無法工作，這可能會導致時程延誤。專案經理首先應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 將任務指派給另一個資源，並要求該資源輪值雙班。
options_zh.B: 更新時程以反映專案工期的變更。
options_zh.C: 向人力資源部門（HR）尋求替代人選，並更新風險登記冊。
options_zh.D: 相應地更新資源管理計畫與資源配置圖。

question_text: A project manager has been using predictive methodology for more than 10 years and is switching to an agile project. The team members have not previously worked together. After two sprints of work, the team has not achieved any outcome and there is a lot of pressure to get work done What kind of leadership style should the project manager use at this stage?

options.A: A directive style that makes decisions for the group to reach early outcomes
options.B: A leadership style that coaches people who want help and fosters greater team collaboration
options.C: A passive leadership style that allows the team to self-organize until the norming stage is reached
options.D: A democratic style that uses techniques where majority opinion prevails

options_list.text: A directive style that makes decisions for the group to reach early outcomes
A leadership style that coaches people who want help and fosters greater team collaboration
A passive leadership style that allows the team to self-organize until the norming stage is reached

chapter_tag: 01. 基礎 (專案定義、生命週期、敏捷思維、PMO)

question_text_zh: 某專案經理使用預測型方法論已超過 10 年，目前正在轉換至敏捷專案。團隊成員先前未曾合作過。經過兩個短衝的工作後，團隊尚未達成任何成果，且完成工作的壓力很大。專案經理在此階段應該採用哪種類型的領導風格？

options_zh.A: 指導型風格：替群體做決策以迅速取得早期成果
options_zh.B: 教練型領導風格：指導需要協助的人，並促進更好的團隊協作
options_zh.C: 被動型領導風格：允許團隊自我組織，直到達到常態期（norming stage）
options_zh.D: 民主型風格：使用以多數意見為主的技術

question_text: During a retrospective review, many project team members say they are not completing tasks during the iterations because of interruptions and requests for help from other teams As a team facilitator, what should the project manager do to avoid this?

options.A: Identify the problem's root causes and define the ground rules with all project team members to minimize interferences
options.B: Hire a coach to help all project teams to improve their abilities to solve problems on their own.
options.C: Reunite with the project team members affected and tell them not to reduce the team's capacity
options.D: Recommend to the project team members that they should improve their planning and make their stones smaller

chapter_tag: 07. 領導及賦能團隊 (衝突管理、僕人式領導、團隊發展階段、情商)
eco_task_tag: ECO 1.2 / 1.3 管理衝突與領導團隊
concept_tag: 團隊章程與基本規則 (Team Charter / Ground Rules)
question_text_zh: 在回顧會議審查期間，許多專案團隊成員表示由於其他團隊的干擾和求助請求，他們無法在反覆迭代期間完成任務。作為團隊推進者（Facilitator），專案經理應該做什麼來避免這種情況？

options_zh.A: 找出問題的根本原因，並與所有專案團隊成員共同訂定基本規則以盡量減少干擾。
options_zh.B: 聘請教練協助所有專案團隊提升其自行解決問題的能力。
options_zh.C: 與受影響的專案團隊成員再次會面，並告訴他們不要降低團隊的產能。
options_zh.D: 建議專案團隊成員改善規劃並縮小其使用者故事。

question_text: A company wants to be a pioneer in its industry and has announced the launch date of a new innovative product. After the first sprint planning, the team realizes that it is not possible to deliver all the features in the required time. What should the project manager do to ensure success? IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 363

options.A: Increase the capacity of the team to deliver the completed backlog on time.
options.B: Ask the customer to reduce the backlog to meet the launch date.
options.C: Assist the team in defining a minimum viable product (MVP) by the launch date.
options.D: Schedule a meeting with the stakeholders to review the contingency plan.

options_list.text: Increase the capacity of the team to deliver the completed backlog on time.
Ask the customer to reduce the backlog to meet the launch date.
Assist the team in defining a minimum viable product (MVP) by the launch date.

chapter_tag: 03. 定義範疇、價值和成功準則 (WBS、待辦清單、允收準則、MVP)

question_text_zh: 某家公司希望成為其產業的先驅，並已宣布了一款創新產品的發布日期。在第一次短衝規劃後，團隊意識到無法在所需的時間內交付所有功能。專案經理應該做什麼以確保成功？

options_zh.A: 增加團隊產能以準時交付完整的待辦清單。
options_zh.B: 要求客戶縮減待辦清單以符合發布日期。
options_zh.C: 協助團隊在發布日期前定義出最小可行產品（MVP）。
options_zh.D: 安排與利害關係人的會議以審查應變計畫。

question_text: A product owner has returned from a meeting with a few key stakeholders, who expressed interest in learning more about the project progress. The product owner is seeking the project manager's recommendation on how to approach this request. What should the project manager do to help the product owner?

options.A: Provide an overview of the completed functionalities and release plan, and capture expectations for future stakeholder involvement.
options.B: Invite the product owner to future demonstrations where they can provide feedback.
options.C: Provide access to the latest user acceptance test (UAT) environment so they can see the solution.
options.D: Remind the product owner of stakeholder accountability, and ask the product owner to determine the appropriate next steps.

concept_tag: 專案管理核心原則與 PMI 思維 (PMI Mindset)
question_text_zh: 產品負責人剛與幾位關鍵利害關係人開完會回來，這些利害關係人表達了希望進一步了解專案進度的意願。產品負責人正在徵詢專案經理的建議，以了解如何處理此要求。專案經理應該做什麼來協助產品負責人？

options_zh.A: 提供已完成功能與發布計畫的總覽，並收集利害關係人未來參與的期望。
options_zh.B: 邀請產品負責人參加未來的展示會，以便他們提供回饋。
options_zh.C: 提供對最新使用者驗收測試（UAT）環境的存取權限，以便他們查看解決方案。
options_zh.D: 提醒產品負責人注意利害關係人的問責機制，並請產品負責人決定適當的下一步。

question_text: In an agile project that is about 45% complete, most team members are siloed and lack an understanding of each other's work. What would have most likely caused this communication breakdown?

options.A: The sprint review meetings were not held regularly.
options.B: The daily standup meetings were not consistently attended.
options.C: The project manager failed to develop a communications management plan.
options.D: The weekly project status reports were not published regularly.

options_list.text: The sprint review meetings were not held regularly.
The daily standup meetings were not consistently attended.
The project manager failed to develop a communications management plan.
The weekly project status reports were not published regularly.

chapter_tag: 06. 溝通與知識傳遞 (溝通管理、資訊發布器、經驗學習)

options_zh.A: 短衝審查會議沒有定期召開。
options_zh.B: 每日站立會議未能持續全員參與。
options_zh.C: 專案經理未能制定溝通管理計畫。
options_zh.D: 每週專案狀態報告未定期發布。

question_text: A large organization decided to adopt an agile methodology based on the trends seen in the industry. The organization invested a large amount of money in adopting it, but after a few months, the implementation failed. What should the project manager have done differently to avoid the implementation failure?

options.A: Conducted agile training for all employees ranging from the project teams through mid- level to upper-level management.
options.B: Conducted a postmortem and captured the learning in organizational process assets (OPAs) for future use.
options.C: Assessed the organization's culture, performed a suitability analysis, and determined the future state.
options.D: Hired a third-party agile delivery team to do the implementation.

question_text_zh: 一家大型組織根據業界趨勢決定採用敏捷方法。組織投入了大量資金導入敏捷，但在幾個月後，推行宣告失敗。專案經理當初應該採取什麼不同的做法來避免推行失敗？

options_zh.A: 為從專案團隊、中階到高階管理階層的所有員工舉辦敏捷培訓。
options_zh.B: 進行事後檢討，並將經驗學習記錄在組織過程資產（OPAs）中供未來使用。
options_zh.C: 評估組織文化，執行適用性分析，並確定未來願景狀態。
options_zh.D: 聘請第三方敏捷交付團隊來負責推行導入。

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)

question_text_zh: 一項新的再生能源專案的先期可行性研究即將獲得核准。為了確保維持專案時程，在先期可行性研究獲得核准的同時，可行性研究的相關活動必須繼續進行。專案經理應如何處理？

options_zh.A: 在等待最終核准的同時，平行推進先期可行性與可行性研究。
options_zh.B: 將可行性活動納入先期可行性研究中，並申請範疇與預算變更。
options_zh.C: 取得核准以在先期可行性研究審核期間，將可行性研究作為平行活動推進。
options_zh.D: 在推進可行性活動之前，先確保獲得先期可行性研究的核准。

question_text: A project is in the execution phase During a few planning sessions the team brought up dependencies and risks based on their knowledge of other project. options.A: Document the project management plans and share them with the company and all team members via email for review

concept_tag: 專案管理計畫書 (Project Management Plan)
question_text_zh: 一個專案正處於執行階段。在幾次規劃會議中，團隊根據他們對其他專案的了解提出了相依性與風險。專案經理也收到公司對於團隊計劃如何以及何時執行驗收測試與培訓活動的詢問。專案經理下一步應該做什麼？

options_zh.A: 編寫專案管理計畫文件，並透過電子郵件發送給公司與所有團隊成員審閱。
options_zh.B: 建立日誌以追蹤風險、假設、議題與相依性，並與利害關係人建立定期審查機制。
options_zh.C: 在時程中增加應變儲備以應對相依性與風險，然後與團隊進行審查。
options_zh.D: 與公司及專案團隊接洽，以確定最佳的行動方案。

options.A: Present the project management plan to the stakeholder and reassure them that they will receive regular project updates.
options.B: Introduce the stakeholder to the project team and invite them to the next iteration review meeting with the IT team.

options.D: Use stakeholder mapping to document the level of influence and interest for the next iteration planning meeting.

chapter_tag: 04. 建立計畫—整合、資源與財務 (專案管理計畫書、資源分配、預算與成本估算)
eco_task_tag: ECO 2.1 / 2.4 / 2.6 整合計畫、資源與財務
concept_tag: 專案管理計畫書 (Project Management Plan)
question_text_zh: 一位因 IT 專案缺乏透明度而感到不滿的關鍵利害關係人，拒絕參加新專案會議的邀請。敏捷專案經理應該怎麼做才能讓該利害關係人參與專案？

options_zh.A: 向該利害關係人展示專案管理計畫，並向其保證將會定期收到專案最新資訊。
options_zh.B: 向專案團隊介紹該利害關係人，並邀請他們參加與 IT 團隊的下一次迭代審查會議。
options_zh.C: 透過遵守專案承諾與利害關係人建立信任，並利用展示會議蒐集回饋並重新調整目標。
options_zh.D: 使用利害關係人對應圖記錄其影響力與利益程度，以供下一次迭代規劃會議使用。

What engagement model should the project manager use for the technical architect role to ensure project success?

options.A: Hire a new technical architect who would be solely dedicated to the current project.
options.B: Share the existing technical architect so they can be allocated to the current project and other projects.
options.C: Hire a new technical architect who would be shared between the current project and other projects.
options.D: Assign the existing technical architect to solely be dedicated to the current project.

question_text_zh: 專案中由於團隊成員的能力不足而遇到了許多問題。這些問題可能導致專案績效不佳，甚至可能導致專案終止。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 與專案團隊組織腦力激盪會議以解決該問題。
options_zh.B: 向專案團隊宣導團隊參與度的重要性。
options_zh.C: 投資於為所有專案團隊成員提供教練指導與培訓。
options_zh.D: 將問題呈報給人力資源（HR）部門以採取行動。

options.B: Schedule a daily project definition meeting with the team to define the project scope before starting the execution.

question_text_zh: 一位經驗豐富的專案經理此前從未管理過敏捷專案。由於該專案的不確定性，專案經理在定義專案範疇時陷入困境，花費了很長時間嘗試進行定義。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 提交變更請求，以運用以往的經驗並採用預測型方法來管理專案。
options_zh.B: 安排與團隊進行每日專案定義會議，以在開始執行前定義專案範疇。
options_zh.C: 開始執行專案，因為範疇將在整個專案過程中不斷被定義和重新定義。
options_zh.D: 在開始執行之前，獲得產品負責人的部分核准以建立專案範疇計畫基準。

options.A: Review the iteration backlog because the product definition has changed and needs to be reassessed before continuing the project.
options.B: Continue work and ask the product owner to assess the changes and add/remove the stories as needed in the backlog.
options.C: Ask a business analyst to assess the changes and then add/remove the stories in the backlog and prioritize them by business value.
options.D: Ask the product owner to add new changes to the bottom of the backlog in order to handle the modifications as a change request.

question_text_zh: 在疊代進行到一半時，產品負責人告知敏捷團隊政府已更新法規要求。這將導致產品定義發生某些變更。專案經理應該如何處理這種情況？

options_zh.A: 審查疊代待辦清單，因為產品定義已改變，在繼續專案之前需要重新評估。
options_zh.B: 繼續工作，並請產品負責人評估變更，根據需要在待辦清單中新增/移除故事。
options_zh.C: 請商業分析師評估變更，然後在待辦清單中新增/移除故事，並按商業價值進行優先排序。
options_zh.D: 請產品負責人將新變更加入待辦清單底部，以便將修改作為變更請求處理。

options_zh.A: 在新產品負責人熟悉產品的同時，承擔起產品負責人的角色。
options_zh.B: 安排時間與新產品負責人分享關於產品和專案資訊的見解。
options_zh.C: 與專案管理辦公室（PMO）主管合作，為新產品負責人制定到職引導計畫。
options_zh.D: 組織團隊建立活動，並要求團隊尊重信任新產品負責人的意見。

question_text_zh: 在執行敏捷專案期間，專案經理發現預算幾乎已耗盡，但專案距離完工還差得很遠。專案經理應採取何種作為來解決此疑慮？

options_zh.A: 審查專案時程表，尋找縮短專案時程的機會。
options_zh.B: 與專案贊助者一起審查預算，並請求增加預算。
options_zh.C: 審查待辦清單，尋找重新排列工作優先順序並縮減專案範疇的機會。
options_zh.D: 審查資源管理計畫書，尋找降低專案成本的機會。

question_text_zh: 一個敏捷團隊在交付標的的品質方面正面臨挑戰。每次將新功能推送至正式環境時，都會出現許多瑕疵，導致客戶無法正常使用該解決方案。專案經理未來應該怎麼做以避免這種情況？

options_zh.A: 建立帶有獎品的團隊激勵計畫，允許團隊成員加班以找出瑕疵。
options_zh.B: 縮短發行週期，並投入更多時間來穩定現有功能，而非發行新功能。
options_zh.C: 聘請品質保證專家，並在目前的專案生命週期中整合第二階段的測試。
options_zh.D: 利用下一次回顧會議了解品質問題的根本原因，並讓團隊提出行動計畫。

options_zh.D: 遵從客戶高階贊助者的判斷，因為他們將決定專案是否成功。

question_text_zh: 專案經理正在領導一個處於執行階段的專案。在一次團隊會議中，專案經理發現有兩名團隊成員缺乏執行後續部分任務所需的技術技能。身為僕人式領導者的專案經理接下來應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 建議團隊成員針對專案需求進行自主技能提升。
options_zh.B: 與人力資源（HR）經理討論更換團隊成員的可能性。
options_zh.C: 向贊助者通報團隊技能不足可能導致的專案延誤。
options_zh.D: 在專案預算範圍內為團隊成員尋找合適的培訓方案。

question_text: A project manager is leading the development of a mobile banking application using a hybrid approach. The team has been holding daily standup meetings each workday morning. Due to an unexpected issue, 50% of the team has to work from home. The bank's management directed the team not to have in-person daily standups. Various team members are complaining about this, stating that there is a lack of information sharing among the team What should the project manager do?

options.A: Postpone the daily standups and ask the team members to update the project manager daily via messaging.
options.B: Hold virtual daily standups each workday morning and use collaboration tools to manage project updates.
options.C: Delegate authority to the team members and ask them to submit weekly status reports instead. IT Certification Guaranteed, The Easy Way! 385
options.D: Ask senior management for permission to hold in-person team meetings once each week.

concept_tag: 混合型生命週期轉換 (Hybrid Approach)
question_text_zh: 一位專案經理正採用混合式方法領導開發一款行動銀行應用程式。團隊每個工作日早晨都會舉行每日站立會議。由於突發狀況，50% 的團隊成員必須在家工作。銀行管理階層指示團隊不得舉行實體的每日站立會議。多位團隊成員對此抱怨，表示團隊間缺乏資訊共享。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 推遲每日站立會議，並要求團隊成員每天透過通訊軟體向專案經理回報最新進度。
options_zh.B: 每個工作日早晨舉行線上虛擬每日站立會議，並使用協作工具管理專案最新動態。
options_zh.C: 對團隊成員授權，並改為要求他們提交每週狀態報告。
options_zh.D: 向高階管理階層申請許可，每週舉行一次實體團隊會議。

options_zh.A: 向上呈報以申請額外的財務資源
options_zh.B: 將請求轉交給專案管理辦公室（PMO）以修改組織程序資產
options_zh.C: 要求專案贊助者取得實施新方法的核准
options_zh.D: 分析在所請求的方法下需要處理的需求

question_text: A team member has indicated their user story will not be finished until the end of the iteration as their functional manager has requested they assist in resolving a high-priority production issue. What should the project manager do?

options.A: Discuss with the product owner that the user story will not be completed this iteration.
options.B: Meet with the team member's functional manager to try to remove the impediment.
options.C: Tell the project team member not to work on the production issue and to inform their manager.
options.D: Escalate the issue to the project sponsor to resolve and adjust the project burndown chart.

question_text_zh: 一位團隊成員表示，由於其職能經理要求其協助解決一項高優先順序的線上生產環境問題，其負責的使用者故事在本次迭代結束前將無法完成。專案經理應該怎麼做？

options_zh.A: 與產品負責人討論該使用者故事無法在本次迭代中完成。
options_zh.B: 與該團隊成員的職能經理會面，設法消除這項障礙。
options_zh.C: 告訴該專案團隊成員不要處理生產環境問題，並告知其經理。
options_zh.D: 將問題向上呈報給專案贊助者以尋求解決，並調整專案燃盡圖。

question_text: During a project meeting, the project manager asks risk owners to present issues that may affect the backlog. During their presentation, the project manager realizes that some risk owners did not implement the already agreed-upon risk responses. What should the project manager do to reduce exposure?

options.A: Report the risk owners to the project management office (PMO) with the recommendation to remove them from the team.
options.B: Reassign the outstanding risk tasks to other team members who have implemented their risk responses.
options.C: Ask the risk owners to implement the risk responses before the next meeting and present the results in the meeting.
options.D: Meet privately with the risk owners and work with them to address any impediments to the risk responses.

options_list.text: Report the risk owners to the project management office (PMO) with the recommendation to remove them from the team.
Reassign the outstanding risk tasks to other team members who have implemented their risk responses.

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)
eco_task_tag: ECO 3.3 / 3.4 / 3.5 風險、變更與障礙議題
concept_tag: 風險回應策略 (Risk Responses)
question_text_zh: 在一次專案會議中，專案經理請各風險負責人報告可能影響待辦清單的議題。在報告過程中，專案經理發現部分風險負責人並未執行先前已議定的風險因應措施。專案經理應採取什麼行動來降低風險曝險？

options_zh.A: 向專案管理辦公室（PMO）通報這些風險負責人，並建議將其移出團隊。
options_zh.B: 將未完成的風險任務重新指派給其他已執行風險因應措施的團隊成員。
options_zh.C: 要求風險負責人在下次會議前落實風險因應措施，並於會議中報告成果。
options_zh.D: 私下與這些風險負責人會面，共同解決落實風險因應措施時所遇到的任何障礙。

options.B: Keep the focus on the priority items while the change goes through the change control process.
options.C: Reject the change request since it may negatively impact the project's performance.
options.D: Implement the change request as soon as possible to avoid accumulating new scope.

chapter_tag: 08. 管理風險、變更和議題 (風險回應、變更管制委員會 CCB、議題紀錄)
